GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>Reports to: Manager, Renewals</p> <p>This is an individual-contributor, tactical role focused on timely, accurate execution rather than strategic decision-making. The Associate Renewals Manager works under the general direction of Senior Renewals Managers and their manager, following specific instructions and frameworks in day-to-day work. Solutions and outputs are reviewed by more senior team members and/or the direct manager.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Manage an assigned portfolio of customer renewals tracking key dates and driving them to on-time closure. </li> <li>Have real, consultative conversations with customers throughout the renewal cycle to understand how they're actually using the product and where they're headed next.</li> <li>Identify and surface expansion opportunities — additional seats, tiers, or modules — that come out of those conversations.</li> <li>Probe for new use cases and unmet needs within existing accounts, connecting what customers describe to relevant GitLab capabilities they aren't yet using.</li> <li>Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule, structuring them to reflect any expansion identified.</li> <li>Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule.</li> <li>Analyze moderately complex renewal situations (usage trends, contract terms, pricing) by reviewing existing account factors, escalating anything unusual to a senior team member or manager and helping to mitigate any risk identified.</li> <li>Explain moderately complex renewal terms and issues to customers and internal stakeholders, working to build alignment.</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to help identify expansion opportunities, resolve blockers and keep renewals moving.</li> <li>Communicate proactively and transparently with customers and internal stakeholders, adapting to GitLab's communication framework.</li> <li>Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM/renewals system for forecasting and reporting.</li> <li>Prioritize tasks with guidance from more senior team members to drive quality, timely results.</li> <li>Contribute to team goals by working collaboratively with peer RM’s.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Can execute basic renewal processes independently ("basic knots") and has been introduced to more advanced scenarios ("complex knots") such as multi-year deals, upsell-attached renewals, or non-standard terms.</li> <li>Developing understanding of GitLab's way of working, values, and high-performance culture.</li> <li>Awareness of GitLab's remote work best practices.</li> <li>Growth mindset and sense of ownership — proactively seeks out ways to learn and improve, and takes action rather than waiting for direction.</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing many renewals at once.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to follow defined processes and frameworks while flagging exceptions appropriately.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset and openness to feedback and coaching from senior teammates and manager.</li> <li><span class="s1">The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing GitLab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. As a Renewal Manager, you'll be part of a quota-carrying team that works closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to ensure timely, accurate renewals and strong customer retention across regions in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. The team is responsible for forecasting renewal outcomes, identifying and addressing churn risk, and uncovering opportunities to expand GitLab adoption, while continuously improving processes and best practices that support predictable, sustainable growth.</p> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a> </li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. You'll design high-level architectures and implementation plans for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, and you'll make sure deliverables align with customer requirements and the Statement of Work (SOW). You'll coordinate and guide implementation work across GitLab Professional Services and partner consultants, support customers deploying GitLab in cloud and on-premises environments using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit, and perform migrations to GitLab using Congregate. You'll provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best practices, contribute reusable collateral such as documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and share product release updates to help the team deliver consistent outcomes. This role combines deep technical expertise with customer-facing leadership in GitLab's remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Designing and delivering GitLab reference architecture implementations for both self-managed and cloud environments, using infrastructure as code practices</li> <li>Leading source code management and CI/CD migrations to GitLab, including large-scale enterprise moves using Congregate</li> <li>Building repeatable delivery kits, documentation, and enablement materials that help Professional Services and partners deploy and adopt GitLab best practices</li> <li>Lead the full technical delivery lifecycle for GitLab Professional Services engagements, from early scoping and technical discovery through implementation and handoff.</li> <li>Produce high-level and detailed technical designs for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, ensuring deliverables align with customer requirements and expectations.</li> <li>Evaluate and communicate scalability and security considerations (including compliance constraints) in proposed GitLab reference architectures and implementation plans.</li> <li>Deploy and configure GitLab in customer environments, including on-premises and major cloud providers, using Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit (GET) aligned to reference architectures.</li> <li>Plan and execute source system migrations to GitLab using Congregate, partnering closely with customer stakeholders to reduce risk, protect data integrity, and minimize downtime.</li> <li>Provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best-practice guidance, including advising on internal frameworks such as the Delivery Governance Framework (DGF) and GitLab Flow.</li> <li>Coordinate and oversee implementation work across GitLab team members, partners, and customer points of contact (POCs), ensuring clear asynchronous communication and decision capture, effective execution, and high-quality outcomes.</li> <li>Mentor Professional Services and partner consultants by contributing documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and by leading enablement sessions on how to deliver and position service offerings.</li> <li>Maintain and improve delivery automation assets with an emphasis on code cleanliness, maintainability, and appropriate unit/integration testing.</li> <li>Support scoping and Statement of Work (SOW) creation with Professional Services Engagement Managers, stay current on monthly GitLab releases, and help Regional Delivery Managers with technical vetting and staffing assessments while maintaining a 55% billable utilization.</li> <li>Review and provide input to Professional Services training materials and presentations</li> <li>Develop case studies, presentations, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies</li> <li>Work closely with customer project teams to ensure accurate task-level articulation of work required</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions with customers and partners and communicate risks/trade-offs clearly in an asynchronous environment.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Prefer location in PST, MST or CST timezone alignment. </strong><strong>Comfortable with up to 30% travel at times.</strong><strong>Demonstrated experience delivering two or more of the following consulting services: source code management migration, cloud architecture, DevOps engineering, or continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) consulting services.</strong><strong>Enterprise software development experience, with the ability to translate requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.</strong><strong>Progressive DevOps platform experience, including designing and implementing reliable, scalable systems with clear performance and security trade-offs.</strong><strong>Hands-on experience deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud providers and on-premises environments, including using tools such as Terraform and Ansible.</strong><strong>Ability to write clean, maintainable automation/integration code (e.g., Terraform modules, Ansible roles, scripts) and validate changes with appropriate testing and code review.</strong><strong>Experience performing migrations to GitLab, including using Congregate or similar migration tooling.</strong><strong>Working knowledge of data consistency and integrity concepts (e.g., ACID properties) and how they impact migration design and performance trade-offs.</strong><strong>Strong problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.</strong><strong>Comfort working in a remote, asynchronous environment, using documented decisions (e.g., issues, proposals, and runbooks) to keep work unblocked across time zones while collaborating effectively across GitLab team members, partners, and customer stakeholders.</strong><strong>Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or other advanced technical degree, or equivalent experience</strong></h4> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Professional Services Technical Architect is part of GitLab's Professional Services organization. We partner with customers who are transitioning to GitLab, expanding how they use an existing GitLab installation, or planning complex upgrades to their infrastructure and processes. Our team brings a diverse set of skills across GitLab deployment, maintenance, and day-to-day usage, along with deep technical knowledge of adjacent tools and platforms. Working closely with Engagement Managers, partner consultants, and customer stakeholders, we focus on delivering high-quality outcomes, sharing best practices, and helping customers realize faster time to value from their GitLab investment. We operate in GitLab's remote, asynchronous environment and rely on clear documentation and transparent communication to collaborate effectively.</p> <p>This role models skills and behavior aligned with GitLab Values and typically reports to the Regional Delivery Manager. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>Credit-based and consumption-based offerings are becoming central to how GitLab monetizes. The systems that meter, rate, and bill that consumption sit underneath all of it. You'll own the backend usage billing pipeline and its product direction while supporting the Monetization Platform and Infrastructure team as it modernizes the foundations underneath it.</p> <p>When another GitLab team launches a credit-consuming capability, you'll help them make it billable across GitLab.com, self-managed, and GitLab Dedicated. This is a technical, systems-oriented product role: success means building a monetization platform other teams can launch on quickly and correctly, rather than shipping customer-facing UI.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the product direction for metering, aggregation, and rating in GitLab's usage billing pipeline, including the Zuora and CustomersDot integrations that turn usage into invoiced revenue.</li> <li>Make onboarding a new credit-consuming capability a repeatable process rather than a bespoke project each time.</li> <li>Partner with product teams on what to instrument, how to meter and price usage across GitLab.com, self-managed, and GitLab Dedicated, and what it takes to be billable on launch day. Stay ahead of their roadmaps so billing doesn't delay launches.</li> <li>Prioritize pipeline scalability, performance, and reliability as consumption grows, balancing those investments against new capability enablement.</li> <li>Own billing defect detection and remediation so errors surface before they reach a customer's invoice and billing outcomes remain auditable.</li> <li>Support the Monetization Platform and Infrastructure team by framing problems, explaining the value of platform investments, and prioritizing them against operational risk.</li> <li>Define and track measures of billing accuracy, pipeline reliability, cost to serve per capability, and time to monetize so teams can make informed pricing decisions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning the product direction of consumption- or usage-based billing systems.</li> <li>Experience with Zuora or a comparable billing and revenue platform, and an understanding of how product and finance systems interact.</li> <li>Experience with prepaid, commitment, or credit-drawdown pricing models (balances, reservations, overage, expiration) and the edge cases they create in billing and revenue.</li> <li>Experience launching new products or pricing models while coordinating across engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance and go-to-market teams.</li> <li>Ability to bring together teams you don't manage around work their launches depend on.</li> <li>Experience defining problems for platform or backend teams whose users are often other teams.</li> <li>Clear written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment; you'll use issues, epics, and direction pages to lead.</li> <li>Familiarity with developer tooling, financial audit or revenue recognition, or an engineering background can help, but isn't required.</li> <li>You use AI tools as part of how you work: prototyping, analysis, spec writing, and investigation.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>In Monetization, we coordinate across engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance and go-to-market on new products and pricing models. title: Enterprise Account Executive - EMEA
description: About Abacum Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance . By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions. Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities . Headquartered in New York , we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex , and hundreds more. We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners , with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator , Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch. Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning! We are looking for... An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed. At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win. title: Supply Chain Manager (all genders)
description: Position: Vollzeit (40h) Ort: Remote (Deutschland) oder Berlin Start Datum: Ab sofort oder nach Absprache Sprachen: Deutsch (fließend) & Englisch (sehr gut) Du hast den Anspruch, dass jede Bestellung stimmt, die deinen Tisch verlässt, und führst Lieferanten in Asien so eng, dass Ware pünktlich und in der richtigen Qualität ankommt? Von deiner Arbeit hängt ab, ob unsere Produkte in den Regalen der größten Drogerieketten verfügbar sind. Das sind wir! Maniko ist ein innovatives, schnell wachsendes Unternehmen in der Nagelkosmetik-Branche, das hochwertige Produkte für anspruchsvolle Kundinnen europaweit anbietet. Wir sind bekannt für unsere selbstklebende UV Gel Nail Strips-Technologie, die professionelle Ergebnisse bequem von zu Hause aus ermöglicht – und haben mit unseren Soft Gel Press-On Nails eine zweite starke Produktlinie im Markt. Unsere Produkte stehen national bei dm, dm Österreich, Rossmann und budni im Regal, und unser Handelsgeschäft wächst weiter. Aus dem Startup ist ein Unternehmen geworden, das im Regal mit den großen Beauty-Marken konkurriert. Groß genug, dass deine Arbeit in tausenden Filialen sichtbar wird, und beweglich genug, dass du Strukturen noch selbst baust, statt sie zu verwalten. Unser Geheimnis? Ein leidenschaftliches Team, das sich nicht mit dem Status quo zufrieden gibt und ständig danach strebt, besser zu werden. Wir glauben an Werte, die wirklich gelebt werden – keine leeren Phrasen. Bei uns heißt es: Facts over Ego: Daten und Ergebnisse stehen über allem – bei uns zählt das Beste für das Team und das Unternehmen, nicht das persönliche Ego. Challenge accepted: Wir sehen in jeder Herausforderung eine Chance, an der wir wachsen können. Power to the people: Vertrauen und Verantwortung gehen bei uns Hand in Hand – dein Impact zählt! Who if not you? : Wenn nicht du die Ärmel hochkrempelst und Dinge anpackst – wer dann? Deine Rolle bei uns: Du bist Owner unserer operativen Beschaffung und berichtest direkt an unseren COO. Aus der monatlichen Absatz- und Bestandsplanung machst du Bestellungen, die pünktlich, vollständig und in vereinbarter Qualität ankommen, und führst dafür unsere Hersteller in Asien und Europa. Dein Erfolg ist messbar: an der Liefertreue unserer Lieferanten und an der Fehlerquote in den Bestellungen. Deine Aufgaben sind : Du verantwortest den Bestellprozess für Fertigware, Komponenten, Verpackung und POS-Material, von der Bestellempfehlung über die Freigabe bis zum Wareneingang. Du führst unsere Hersteller in Asien und Europa durch Auftragsbestätigung, Produktion, Qualitätsprüfung vor Verschiffung und Versanddokumente. Bei Verzug eskalierst du früh und bringst eine Lösung mit. Du misst Lieferantenleistung über eine Scorecard (Termintreue, Qualität, Reaktionszeit) und machst Abweichungen sichtbar, bevor sie zum Problem werden. Du hältst Stücklisten, Spezifikationen und Artikeldaten so sauber, dass sich Planung, Logistik und Handel darauf verlassen können. Du steuerst mit Finance Anzahlungen und Fälligkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Zertifikate und Konformitätsnachweise unserer Lieferanten vollständig vorliegen. Du entwickelst den Prozess weiter: Standards für neue Lieferanten und Komponenten, Kontrollen, Automatisierung. Wo ein Tool oder KI dir Arbeit abnimmt, setzt du es ein. Was du mitbringst: Du hast mehrere Jahre operative Beschaffung mit Herstellern in Asien eigenverantwortlich gesteuert, idealerweise für eine Konsumgütermarke mit Handelsbelieferung. Du arbeitest genau, weil du ein System dafür hast, nicht weil du langsam bist. Du kannst zeigen, wie du Fehler abfängst, bevor eine Bestellung rausgeht. Du führst Lieferanten freundlich und hartnäckig, auch über Zeitzonen hinweg, und bleibst dran, bis ein Termin wirklich steht. Du wartest nicht auf Anweisung. Wenn etwas schiefläuft, sprichst du es früh an und bringst einen Vorschlag mit. Du bist sehr sicher in Excel/Sheets, sprichst fließend Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch. Idealerweise bringst du außerdem mit: Erfahrung mit Komponenten aus der Beauty-/Kosmetik- oder FMCG-Branche (z. B. Verpackung, Applikatoren). ERP- bzw. Dispo-Erfahrung (PO-Workflows, Stammdaten). Erfahrung mit Pre-Shipment-Inspections bzw. QC-Dienstleistern. Was wir dir bieten: 🇪🇺 100 % Remote in Deutschland: Remote-first mit optionalem Büro in Berlin. Der Reiseanteil ist gering, gelegentliche Lieferantenbesuche gehören dazu. ⏱️ Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Somit kannst du privates und berufliches flexibel und entspannt vereinbaren. 🚉 Deutschlandticket: Für mehr Flexibilität und Mobilität. 🏃‍♀️Urban Sports Club Membership: Weil wir wissen, wie wichtig physische Gesundheit und Ausgleich ist. 🤝 Ownership: Durch viel Vertrauen & Gestaltungsspielraum hast du direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens und gestaltest maßgeblich unser Wachstum mit. 🌴 Workation: Deine Möglichkeit Urlaub und Arbeit zu verbinden. 📈 Wachstumschancen: Sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich. Bei uns kannst du dich weiterentwickeln und neue Wege gehen, unterstützt durch ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget. 🎉 Team-Events: Wir laden alle Mitarbeiter:innen regelmäßig nach Berlin ein, um eine gute Zeit zusammen zu haben und noch besser connecten zu können. 🖥️ Home-Office Ausstattung: Wir übernehmen deine komplette Ausstattung, damit du auch zu Hause direkt durchstarten kannst. ✈️ Individuelles Travelbudget: Für deine Besuche in Berlin, um gemeinsam mit dem Team aus dem Office zu arbeiten. 👥 Team: Ein schnelles, hochmotiviertes Team mit Office im Herzen von Berlin (Hackescher Markt). ✨ Eine Kultur, die inspiriert: Bei uns zählt jeder Einzelne. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und echte Teamarbeit stehen im Mittelpunkt. Challenge accepted? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil eines Teams, das große Ziele verfolgt und dabei nie den Spaß verliert. Wir freuen uns auf dich! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You’ll work closely with sales and internal teams to keep deals on track while protecting GitLab’s interests.</p> <p>You’ll be part of the team that helps GitLab do business every day, bringing pace, precision, and good judgment to a broad range of commercial legal work. title: Account Executive (m/w/d) – B2B SaaS / Enterprise
description: Introduction Als Account Executive bei Omnora übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle im operativen B2B SaaS Vertrieb mit Fokus auf Enterprise-Kunden und gehobenen Mittelstand. Du verantwortest deine eigene Pipeline, führst Deals strukturiert zum Abschluss und baust nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen auf, immer mit dem Ziel, echten Business Impact bei unseren Kunden zu erzeugen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Senior Sales und Leadership Team zusammen, bekommst klares Sparring und hast die Perspektive, dich mittelfristig in eine Lead- oder Senior-Rolle weiterzuentwickeln, wenn du dazu bereit bist. About The Role And Potential Progression In dieser Rolle bist du vor allem operativ im Vertrieb aktiv : Du identifizierst relevante Accounts, führst Discovery Calls, orchestrierst komplexe Sales-Zyklen und bringst Deals über die Ziellinie. Gleichzeitig lernst du unsere Sales-Frameworks, Prozesse und Playbooks in der Tiefe kennen, mit der klaren Perspektive: Ausbau zum Senior Account Executive (größere, komplexere Accounts, größere Ticketgrößen) Optionale Entwicklung zur Lead-Rolle (z. B. Coaching jüngerer Kolleg:innen, Ownership für bestimmte Teilsegmente oder Branchen) What's in it for you Was dich bei uns erwartet – für Macher:innen mit Anspruch: Leistungsorientierte Vergütung: Fixgehalt + transparenter, quartalsweiser Bonus, der echten Impact belohnt – nicht Aktivität um der Aktivität willen. Klares Spielfeld & starke Story: Ein marktreifes Produkt mit klarer Positionierung, realen Business Cases bei Enterprise-Kunden und einem Markt mit hohem Momentum (Wissen & KI im Unternehmen). Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung: Du arbeitest nah an den Entscheidern, bekommst schnelles Feedback und kannst deine Ideen unmittelbar einbringen. Kultur echter Exzellenz: Ambitionierte Kolleg:innen, hohe Standards und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld mit Vertrauen, Klarheit und Wertschätzung – ohne Politik und ohne Bullshit. Flexibles Arbeiten, klare Erwartungen: Remote-friendly mit Optionen für Onsite-Tage. Wichtig ist dein Beitrag zum Ergebnis, nicht die Optik. Stabiles & wachsendes Umfeld: Profitables Wachstum, langfristige Perspektive und ein Thema, das für Unternehmen geschäftskritisch ist: mitarbeitergeneriertes Wissen & Intelligence Management. How you can make an impact In dieser Rolle kannst du echten Unterschied machen, indem du: Eigene Pipeline verantwortest: Du identifizierst Zielkunden (Konzerne & gehobener Mittelstand), qualifizierst Leads und baust einen belastbaren Dealflow über verschiedene Kanäle auf. Discovery & Needs Analyse auf Enterprise-Level führst: Du verstehst Buying Center, Stakeholder-Dynamiken und die Business-Pain-Points rund um Wissen, Enablement und Produktivität. Komplexe SaaS-Deals strukturierst: Du steuerst den gesamten Sales-Cycle von Erstkontakt über Demo, Business Case, Proof of Value bis hin zu Verhandlungen und Abschluss. Mit klaren Frameworks arbeitest: Du nutzt und entwickelst strukturierte Sales-Frameworks (z. B. MEDDIC / SPICED / Challenger), dokumentierst sauber im CRM und machst Deals damit plan- und skalierbar. Eng mit Marketing & Product zusammenarbeitest: Du spielst systematisch Marktfeedback zurück, hilfst bei der Schärfung von ICP & Messaging und trägst dazu bei, unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie weiterzuentwickeln. Kundenbeziehungen aufbaust: Du bist für deine Accounts ein vertrauensvoller Sparringspartner, positionierst Omnora als strategische Lösung und denkst frühzeitig in Expansion und Upsell. Omnora nach außen repräsentierst: Du nimmst an ausgewählten Events, Messen oder digitalen Formaten teil und trägst unser Value Proposition in den Markt. title: Account Executive France
description: Are you prepared to fuel the growth of an exciting scale-up that's transforming the logistics industry? Do you thrive on building strategic relationships and close deals? But building a fast-growing international SaaS scale-up that’s transforming how some of the world’s largest industrial companies operate? That’s a different story. These companies have hundreds of trucks (un)loading every month, and our SaaS platform helps them orchestrate that whole process. Peripass is a high-impact SaaS platform used in international enterprise environments. Want to be part of this adventure ? fully remote, asynchronous work environment.</li> <li>The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>We title: Director, Strategic Finance
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As Director, Strategic Finance at GitLab, you'll own a small number of complex, company-wide problems from defining the problem through execution and handoff. You'll turn long-range strategy into financial choices and build pricing, deal, and commercial frameworks that help Sales move faster with better economics.</p> <p>You'll join an intentionally small, senior team within Strategic Finance & BizOps. You'll work with significant autonomy, bring together the functions needed to solve each problem, and transfer ongoing ownership once a capable business-partner team is in place. </p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Translate GitLab's long-range strategy into financial scenarios, capacity plans, and investment choices that inform the annual operating plan.</li> <li value="2">Own company-wide initiatives, such as sales and engineering capacity, hosting costs, or product pricing, from problem definition through decision, execution, and handoff to the long-term owner.</li> <li value="3">Build and evolve pricing, packaging, and discounting frameworks using unit economics and market context. Give Sales practical tools, including recommended deal structures, minimum acceptable economics, and clear escalation paths.</li> <li value="4">Partner with Deal Desk to model non-standard and enterprise deals. Advise on financial terms and trade-offs for large, multi-year, usage-based, and partner-led agreements.</li> <li value="5">Design dashboards, budget unlocks, and investment gates that replace one-off approvals with clear guardrails operators can act on independently.</li> <li value="6">Work across Finance, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Data to solve problems that span functions or don't yet have a natural long-term owner.</li> <li value="7">Build the analytical and modeling capability needed for executive decisions. Move beyond requested analysis to proactive, prioritized recommendations, and turn complex models into clear recommendations for the chief executive officer, chief financial officer, and senior leadership.</li> <li value="8">Use artificial intelligence and automation to reduce manual data preparation and expand the team's capacity for insight and execution.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">10+ years of experience as an investor, banker, consultant, strategic finance leader, chief of staff, or operator in a complex technology or software business. You've owned ambiguous, cross-functional problems such as pricing, deal desk, capacity planning, or strategic planning.</li> <li value="2">The ability to build complex, flexible financial models from scratch, including capacity plans, unit economics, pricing scenarios, and deal economics, and translate the detail into executive-level recommendations.</li> <li value="3">Strategic financial judgment that connects operational choices to growth, gross margin, cash flow, profitability, return on invested capital, and opportunity cost rather than relying on simplistic productivity ratios.</li> <li value="4">A track record of influencing Product, go-to-market, or executive decisions through quantitative analysis, not just reporting on outcomes.</li> <li value="5">Experience shaping pricing, packaging, or deal-structure decisions using unit economics. Experience with consumption-based or hybrid pricing is particularly helpful.</li> <li value="6">Comfort working in a changing environment where data and processes are incomplete. You can build frameworks rather than only administer an established recurring process.</li> <li value="7">The ability to represent the team credibly in senior forums, hold a point of view, and challenge weak assumptions constructively.</li> <li value="8">Practical, hands-on use of artificial intelligence to automate workflows, prototype tools, and scale your output, along with expertise in Google Sheets and the ability to use GitLab. GitLab uses Google Sheets rather than Excel for modeling.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Strategic Finance is GitLab's cross-functional problem-solving and incubation team. The team takes on the chief financial officer's and chief executive officer's hardest, most ambiguous problems when no natural owner yet has the capability to solve them. We build the financial and operating frameworks, bring together the relevant functions, and then transfer ongoing ownership to the right business-partner team. Our current portfolio spans company-wide resource allocation and long-range planning, sales and engineering capacity, product pricing, discounting and deal structure, and hosting cost strategy.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. title: Sr. Manager, Data Science
description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: As the Senior Manager, Data Science leading our UK team, you will be one of the earliest members of Hims & Hers' data science function in the UK, joining as we stand up the team alongside the company's new technology hub there. You will help shape how the UK team works and grows from this early stage, without a long-established structure to inherit. You are equal parts technical leader and people leader: you set the roadmap for what your UK team builds and in what order, unblock technical decisions when the path forward is unclear, and develop your reports into stronger technical leaders themselves. You will report to the Director of Data Science (based in the US) and operate as one team with our US-based data scientists, not a separate satellite. That means real day-to-day collaboration across the Atlantic: shared standards, a shared roadmap, and enough overlap in working hours to pair on hard problems. You will work closely with the Director to figure out how to best organize a team split across two countries, from how work gets divided to how the team is structured, so that it delivers the most impact to the business rather than just replicating a US structure overseas. You will partner directly with Finance, Marketing, and Operations leadership to translate business priorities into a team roadmap, then make sure that roadmap actually ships. You Will: Help Establish the UK Team: As one of the earliest members of the UK team, help shape the working norms, technical culture, and onboarding experience for the data scientists who join after you. Lead as One Distributed Team: Operate the UK team as a single function with the US-based data science org, not a separate silo, keeping standards, context, and priorities consistent across the time zone gap. Shape the Roadmap: Partner with the Director of Data Science and the US team to prioritize competing requests from Marketing, Operations, Product, and Finance into a shared roadmap, and help make the tradeoff calls for what the UK team builds and when. Stay Technically Close: Review designs and code at a level of depth that lets you catch bad technical decisions early, even though you are not the one writing production code day to day. Unblock Ambiguity: Step into the highest-ambiguity problems on the team's roadmap when your team needs a second set of hands or a tie-breaking technical call. Set the Technical Bar: Establish and enforce the standards (code review, documentation, model monitoring, experimentation rigor) your team builds against, consistent with the US team and in partnership with Staff-level ICs. Own Delivery: Take accountability for whether your team's 0-to-1 builds actually ship, work reliably in production, and deliver the business outcome they were built for. You Have: 8+ years of experience in Data Science or ML Engineering, including 2+ years directly managing data scientists or ML engineers. Early-Stage Team Experience: Track record of joining or helping shape a brand-new team, office, or region from an early stage, rather than only working within an established structure. Distributed/International Collaboration: Experience working on or leading a team split across countries or significant time zones, comfortable with the communication overhead and async workflows that requires. Proven People Leadership: Track record of developing and retaining data science talent, including calibrating performance and managing through periods of team growth. Technical Credibility: Strong enough in Python, SQL, and applied ML (regression/classification, time-series, causal methods) to review your team's technical decisions and unblock them, even without writing production code daily. Prioritization Under Constraint: Demonstrated ability to help sequence a roadmap across competing stakeholder demands with limited headcount, and to make a clear, well-reasoned case for tradeoffs even when the final call is shared with others. Executive Communication: Comfortable translating technical work into a narrative for senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders, and negotiating scope and timeline with them directly. Engineering Rigor: Familiarity with production ML systems (cloud environments, CI/CD, ML Ops) sufficient to hold your team to a real production bar, not just notebook-quality work. Education: BS, MS, or PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Physics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent experience. We weigh hands-on empirical research experience, such as a thesis or lab-based program, over the specific field of study. Preferred Qualifications: US/UK Collaboration, Specifically: Direct experience working across a US/UK (or similar transatlantic) split team, ideally within a company still establishing its presence in one of those regions. Advanced Business ML (experience leading or reviewing work in 1-2 of the following): Customer Behavior & Propensity Modeling: churn, propensity-to-buy, lead scoring, or lifetime value (LTV) models used to drive targeted marketing and product interventions. Applied Forecasting: time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, or demand/revenue planning under limited historical data. Optimization: marketing spend, inventory, or resource allocation engines. Marketing Measurement: marketing mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, or incrementality testing to measure media effectiveness and inform budget allocation across channels. Industry Experience: healthcare, DTC/subscription, or pharma background is a plus, not a requirement. We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match. Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at To learn more about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose Personal Information, please visit our Global Candidate Privacy Statement . title: Operational Controls Lead
location: London or remote within the UK
description: About Griffin Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences. We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more. We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies. Learn more about what we do Our culture We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible. We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life. We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified. Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers. Learn more about our culture. The team You'll join our Operational Controls team within the Service guild, working across all operations functions. This team is the backbone of how Griffin stays compliant and keeps operational risk visible and manageable as we scale. The opportunity We're looking for someone to become the person who tells us, with confidence, whether our operations are actually working the way we think they are. You'll build and run our first-line controls programme from the ground up, working across deeply technical specialists and senior stakeholders alike. As Griffin scales, our control framework has to scale with it. You'll be central to making that happen, turning quality controls and assurance into a genuine source of confidence for the business. What success looks like In your first year, you'll have built meaningful relationships across every corner of Griffin, from operations teams to second line risk and compliance. You'll have helped stand up our controls capabilities from scratch, and you'll have taken full ownership of the RCSA process for the Service guild. Along the way, you'll have developed the QA/QC testing frameworks and MI that help leadership see exactly where our controls are strong and where they need attention. To do this you'll own Quality assurance reviews and quality control testing across operations, ensuring processes are executed accurately and in line with approved procedures Sample-based testing and control checks, identifying errors, control gaps, exceptions, and potential operational risks Corrective action and remediation plans, working with operations teams to close out issues within agreed timelines The Service guild controls attestation framework, and support risk owners in first-line RCSA exercises QA/QC testing frameworks, control checklists, sampling methodologies, and quality standards Regular QA/QC reporting and MI, feeding into Griffin-wide operational risk reporting Coordination of internal audit, external audit, compliance, risk, and regulatory reviews, providing evidence of operational controls and remediation We expect you to shape this role: This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves,that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are. Your background We're looking for people who have: Strong experience in Operations QA/QC, control testing, transaction testing, or operational risk management within a bank or financial institution Experience reviewing operational processes and identifying errors, exceptions, control weaknesses, and process gaps Experience making recommendations to strengthen controls. Strong analytical and MI/data analysis skills, with experience producing QA/QC reports, dashboards, and trend analysis The ability to challenge Operations constructively and operate with an independent control mindset A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write ) What can we offer you? We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future. Salary: £50-60k (DOE) Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year) Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment. As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks. How long will the process take? Du überführst komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Projekte in einen planbaren und verlässlichen Rollout neuer Standorte. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards. Jede neue Ladesäule als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit beschleunigt die Verkehrswende und ist ein wichtiger Beitrag für eine emissionsfreie Mobilität. title: Intermediate-Senior Backend Engineer (Ruby), Plan: Spec-Driven Development
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Backend Engineer on the Plan: Spec-Driven Development team, you'll help build GitLab's intent-to-code loop: agentic workflows that turn a stated intent into a refined work item, an implementation plan, and verified, mergeable code. You'll own early-stage backend work across the flows, application programming interfaces, data models, and evaluation systems behind this experience, using Ruby on Rails, Python, PostgreSQL, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, large language model application programming interfaces, and an artificial intelligence gateway.</p> <p>You'll join a small, distributed team working on one of GitLab's highest-visibility product bets, collaborating with design partners toward a public beta. In your first year, you'll lead major features from an unclear problem through release, help shape scope with product and users, mentor other engineers, and influence technical decisions across agent workflows and evaluation methods.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead backend features from early product discussions through technical design, implementation, rollout, and post-launch learning.</li> <li>Build the flows, application programming interfaces, and data models behind agent-generated work items, implementation plans, durable specifications, and mergeable code.</li> <li>Develop evaluation and benchmarking systems that measure workflow quality, token cost, and success rate.</li> <li>Use Ruby on Rails and Python to build reliable production systems, with PostgreSQL, GraphQL, representational state transfer, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, large language model application programming interfaces, and an artificial intelligence gateway.</li> <li>Collaborate directly with product, design, engineers, design partners, and users to shape scope and make practical trade-offs.</li> <li>Coordinate multi-person projects across the team and communicate decisions clearly in GitLab's asynchronous, all-remote environment.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical direction across the Plan group and related artificial intelligence initiatives.</li> <li>Work in short iterations, share progress through demos, and use results and user feedback to guide what comes next.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> title: Staff Data Scientist
location: Barcelona; Cardiff, London or Remote (UK); London
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><h4>📍 London or Barcelona | UK remote | 💰 £124,400 - 165,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a> — <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/data">Data</a></h4> <p>We’re looking for a Staff Data Scientist excited to help build the bank of the future. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong commercial judgement and can apply both to Monzo’s most important and complex challenges.</p> <p>At Monzo, we’re building a bank that is fair, transparent and a delight to use. We’re growing extremely fast and have over 11 million customers in the UK. We’ve built a product that people love and more than 80% of our growth comes from word of mouth and referrals.</p> <p><em>Enable Monzo to Make Better Decisions, Faster</em></p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker, which gives data scientists the headspace to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>As a Staff Data Scientist, you’ll lead efforts on strategically important, business-critical problems. You’ll apply judgement in areas of organisational or technical complexity, steward initiatives end-to-end, and focus your hands-on contribution where it can create the greatest impact. You’ll be a trusted technical partner to senior leaders, raise the bar for Data Science across Monzo, and build capability in others through coaching, reusable approaches and clear standards.</p> <h4><strong>Our Data Science team ⭐</strong></h4> <p>We are excited to be expanding and are hiring across our Data Science teams. Whether your interests lie in Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Fincrime, Wealth or Core, we are looking for versatile people who can contribute across squads and collectives. While we allocate teams after the interview process, we aim to match your skills and aspirations with the most suitable role. Throughout the process, you will meet team members from across our Data Science collectives, who will guide you through the opportunities available. Join us and be part of shaping our future!</p> <h4><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Shape and lead the data strategy for a large domain or collective, connecting customer and commercial goals to a clear portfolio of high-impact Data Science work</li> <li>Identify, frame and lead strategically important problems where the path is ambiguous, dependencies span teams, and decisions involve meaningful customer, commercial, regulatory or operational trade-offs</li> <li>Partner with senior leaders across product, engineering, ML, design, research, risk and operations, bringing an independent technical perspective that influences strategy and turns it into measurable outcomes</li> <li>Establish measurement strategies and metric maps that clarify how customer behaviour, product changes and business outcomes connect, enabling teams to test assumptions and make better decisions faster</li> <li>Set and evolve best practices for experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, optimisation and decision science, choosing methods that are proportionate to the decision and its risks</li> <li>Remain hands-on where your expertise is most valuable: exploring complex data, designing analyses and experiments, building models or prototypes, and resolving the hardest technical questions</li> <li>Steward critical data products and initiatives end-to-end, ensuring they are robust, well-governed, clearly documented and adopted by the people who need them</li> <li>Balance pace and analytical rigour, making pragmatic trade-offs while protecting the quality, reproducibility and interpretability of your work</li> <li>Raise Data Science standards across Monzo through technical direction, proposals, reviews, reusable methods and thoughtful challenge</li> <li>Coach and mentor data scientists and analytics engineers, using live projects and wider discipline initiatives to build sustainable capability beyond your own individual output</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have an exceptional track record of leading complex, business-critical Data Science work from ambiguous problem framing through to measurable outcomes</li> <li>You have shaped strategy across a large product or business domain and can influence senior leaders through clear, independent judgement</li> <li>You bring deep expertise across several Data Science disciplines and can set the technical direction for work involving significant complexity, uncertainty or risk</li> <li>You repeatedly create clarity across organisational boundaries, resolve difficult dependencies and turn long-term strategy into decisive action</li> <li>You communicate complex ideas, assumptions and risks with clarity, and hold a consistently high bar for analytical quality, governance and reproducibility</li> <li>You remain a highly credible hands-on practitioner with SQL and Python, while raising standards and multiplying the impact of experienced colleagues</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves:</p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Call</li> <li>Initial Call</li> <li>Technical assessment</li> <li>Final Interviews <ul> <li>Business Fit/Collaboration</li> <li>Case Study</li> <li>Technical Interview</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 2–3 weeks, but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>For more insight into the hiring experience at Monzo, check out our blog post written by one of our Recruiters - <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/21/data-hiring-at-monzo">Data Hiring at Monzo</a>.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></h4> <p><strong>💰 £124,400 - £165,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits</strong></p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍 This role can be based in our London or Barcelona offices, but we’re also open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕ And much more - see our full list of <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>.</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we’ll make this happen whenever we can — whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Junior Backend Developer (Python) (M/W/D) 20H Stellenbeschreibung Read Description Before
description: uNaice ist Pionier im Bereich der automatisierten Contentproduktion und automatisierten Datenaufbereitung und -anreicherung. B. AWS, Azure oder vergleichbares) Erfahrung mit Versionierung (Git), CI/CD, Testing‑Frameworks Interesse an Textautomatisierung, semantischen Daten / Ontologien etc. Benefits Das bieten wir dir: Einflussreiche Rolle in einem zukunftsorientierten Produktteam bei einem innovationsgetriebenen Unternehmen Arbeiten an DataContentNaicer – einer Lösung, die echtes KI-Potential zur Datenoptimierung erschließt (bis zu 80 % Zeitersparnis, Attributerweiterungen, API‑Integration) Agile Arbeitsweise, offene Kommunikation und Raum für kreative Lösungen Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und moderne Technologien Karriereperspektiven – Entwickle dich mit uns weiter und sammle wertvolle Erfahrungen für deine Zukunft. Remote arbeiten zu 100% Zeitsouveränes arbeiten: Du planst deine Arbeiten & Zeit grundsätzlich selbst, sie müssen jedoch in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Kollegen harmonieren (Zeitfenster, aus Erfahrung Mo-Fr 7-18 Uhr) Rahmenbedingungen & Vergütung Arbeitszeit: je nach Vereinbarung, idealerweise zwischen 20h, perspektifisch anwachsend. Vergütung: abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation, es wird gemeinsam eine faire Lösung gefunden Vertrag: unbefristet, bezahlte Probearbeit mit Aufgabenpaketen möglich So bewirbst du dich: Deinen Lebenslauf Ein kurzes Anschreiben, in dem du erklärst, warum du Backend‑Entwicklung und speziell Python spannend findest und was du bisher gemacht hast Beispiele / Referenzen oder Codeprojekte, wenn vorhanden Wir arbeiten ausschließlich remote. Unsere Mitarbeiter sind verteilt an unterschiedlichen Orten in Deutschland. Remote bedeutet nicht unprofessionell. Wir setzen einen geeigneten Arbeitsraum voraus. title: Lead Generation & Growth Specialist

description: Location: Remote / Europe Type: Full-time or part-time – open to experienced students Experience: Minimum 2 years hands-on B2B lead generation experience About GoodsTag GoodsTag is a European technology company helping manufacturers and brands digitize product information and comply with new EU product regulations. A major focus is the Digital Product Passport (DPP): upcoming EU requirements that will require many products to carry digitally accessible information about their composition, origin, sustainability, compliance, repair or recycling — typically accessible through a QR code. We work across industries including batteries, textiles, electronics, consumer goods and packaging. These new regulations create a fast-growing market for solutions connecting product data, compliance and digital consumer information. title: Enterprise Account Executive (UK/EU)
description: ABOUT NASH Nash is last-mile delivery infrastructure. We help the world's largest retailers and commerce companies orchestrate, optimize, and manage their delivery operations. Founded in San Francisco in 2021, backed by Andreessen Horowitz and Y Combinator, Nash works with enterprise customers across North America, Europe, APAC, and the Middle East. Our platform sits at the center of complex delivery operations: connecting carriers, optimizing routes, managing fleets, and giving operators the visibility and control they need to run delivery at scale. We're not a marketplace. We're the infrastructure layer that makes the whole system work. Every enterprise customer presents a different operational reality. A grocery chain running same-day delivery from hundreds of stores has different constraints than a retailer consolidating three carrier networks into one. Nash doesn't sell a fixed product off a price sheet. We design and configure solutions around how each customer actually operates, then deploy with dedicated engineering and product support. The sales process is inseparable from the solution design process. THE OPPORTUNITY Nash has an established and growing UK and European business anchored by strategic enterprise work in the UK. The next phase is building a repeatable enterprise revenue engine across the region, and that starts with this role. You'll own a set of named enterprise accounts across the UK and Europe's grocery, retail, convenience, pharmacy, quick commerce, and logistics sectors, and run the full sales cycle: identifying the right targets, opening doors, running discovery, shaping the solution with our product team, negotiating, and closing. This is a quota-carrying role with real support behind it, from product and engineering through to regional leadership, in a market where delivery has moved from an afterthought to core infrastructure. Deals at Nash aren't won on features. A signed partnership here means you understood a customer's operation deeply enough to design something they couldn't build with their current stack, and you built the commercial case that made the investment obvious. WHAT YOU'LL DO BUILD PIPELINE FROM ZERO Build and manage a pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities across the UK and Europe. That means identifying and prioritizing named accounts, developing a high-touch plan for each one, and running a disciplined outbound motion: strategic networking, targeted outreach, and well-prepared first meetings. Nash already works with one of the UK's leading grocery retailers. Your job is to convert that credibility into new partnerships, account by account. RUN FULL SALES CYCLES, END TO END Own each opportunity from first conversation to signed partnership. Each deal starts with understanding a customer's delivery operation in detail: how orders flow, which carriers run which zones, where manual workarounds mask systemic problems, what their cost structure actually looks like. From there you shape the proposal with Nash's product and engineering teams: which products apply, how they integrate with existing systems, what the deployment sequence looks like, what outcomes the customer should expect and when. Then you negotiate and close. BUILD EXECUTIVE RELATIONSHIPS Establish and grow C-level relationships within your named accounts. Enterprise buying in the UK and Europe runs on structured procurement as much as relationships: RFPs, security reviews, data protection assessments, pilots with defined success criteria. You know how to build champions who carry a deal through that process rather than around it. You'll also spend real time in the field, with operators as well as executives, because the people running the delivery operation day to day are the ones who tell you where the deal actually is. RUN A DISCIPLINED PIPELINE Maintain accurate pipeline data, deal stages, forecasts, and next steps in the CRM. Feed what you learn in the field back to product and marketing: which objections repeat, where competitors win, what the market is asking for that we don't build yet. Your deal notes shape our roadmap. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 6 months: A qualified pipeline of named enterprise accounts with clear next steps and honest stage data First new deals closed or in final stages A documented outbound playbook for the region: messaging, sequencing, and what converts Strong working relationships with Nash's product and engineering teams First 12 months: Meaningful new revenue closed against quota, with complex, high-value transactions in the mix Multi-threaded executive relationships across your account set A repeatable enterprise sales motion for the UK and Europe that the next hire can run WHO YOU ARE You have 7+ years in a full-cycle, closing sales role, with a track record of consistent quota over-achievement on complex enterprise deals, including transactions of $1M+ ARR. You've owned C-level relationships, and you're comfortable building pipeline through your own outbound rather than waiting for marketing to hand it to you. You sell by understanding, not by pitching. When a Head of Supply Chain describes their delivery model, you listen for the constraints and trade-offs, not just the pain points. You ask the questions that uncover the real problem, and you can hold a technical conversation about integrations and deployment without handing it off. You communicate clearly at every level, from the C-suite to the engineers scoping the integration, and you can carry a complex value story without jargon. An existing network in UK or European retail, grocery, quick commerce, or logistics is valuable. Fluency in a major European language is a plus as we grow on the continent. A consulting or solution-engineering background is also a plus, not a prerequisite. What matters is that you've closed, repeatedly, in deals where the solution had to be designed rather than picked off a price sheet. This role is probably not right for: Sellers who need a mature playbook, an SDR team, and marketing-sourced pipeline. The support here is real, but the motion is build-it-yourself: you find the accounts, you open them, you close them. HOW THIS ROLE WORKS You join a small, high-performing UK/EU team alongside a Customer Success function and regional leadership. Nash is a startup. The team is lean. You'll have significant autonomy and direct access to Nash's founders, product leaders, and engineering team. That access isn't ceremonial. You'll be in product discussions regularly, shaping what Nash builds based on what you're learning in the field. The role is based in London, with regular travel across the UK and Europe. The first 90 days are weighted toward account mapping, first meetings, and pipeline build. Closing follows the work. More about Nash Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics. Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line. Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion. We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it. Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco. What You’ll Love About Us ✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career! ✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates ✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity ✅ Flexible paid time off ✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees
