title: Director of People Operations
description: About Tekmetric Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better. Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably. Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset. But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time. Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair. Working the Tekmetric Way At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together. We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here. We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders. Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you. At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection . We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported. What You’ll Do We’re looking for a Director of People Operations who is energized by what’s ahead: a strong foundation to build on, a business that’s moving fast, and a real opportunity to shape what comes next. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role where strategy and execution live in the same seat. You’ll own the operational backbone of the People function — total rewards, HR systems, compliance, people analytics, and Finance partnership — and be a key member of the People leadership team. This role operates at all altitudes. You will focus on these areas: Operational Excellence & Scalable Systems Own and continuously improve the systems, workflows, and operating rhythms that power the employee lifecycle—from performance and compensation cycles to core people operations. Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and utilize AI to scale processes that support Tekmetric’s continued growth across multi-state and international teams. Total Rewards & Compensation Strategy Lead the evolution of Tekmetric’s compensation and benefits programs to ensure they remain competitive, scalable, and aligned to business goals. Oversee salary benchmarking, leveling, calibration, and rewards strategy in close partnership with Finance. Risk, Compliance & Governance Own compliance across federal, state, local, and international employment requirements—revising the policies, practices, and Legal partnerships as needed to protect the business while enabling speed and smart decision-making. People Analytics & Workforce Intelligence Leverage people data, HRIS reporting, and AI tools to surface actionable workforce insights that inform business decisions. Translate trends in retention, engagement, compensation equity, and organizational health into clear recommendations and measurable action. People Team Leadership & Functional Evolution Report to and partner closely with the VP of People & Culture while collaborating across the broader People team to continuously evolve Tekmetric’s people programs, operating model, and team effectiveness as the company scales. What You’ll Bring This role is for the HR/People leader who has done the real work - built programs, fixed broken processes, led and developed teams, navigated hard situations - and you’re looking for a place where that experience can have real impact. You’re a player-coach at heart: you get genuine energy from developing the people on your team, and you’re equally energized by owning the operational work yourself. Tekmetric moves fast - and we mean it. Priorities shift, decisions happen quickly, and the expectation is that you move with the business, not behind it. If you thrive in an environment where the ground is always moving and you see that as a feature, keep reading. Here’s what we’re looking for: Years of Experience 10+ years of progressive People/HR experience Proven experience leading an HR/People team in a high-growth SaaS company , scaling through 40–60%+ YoY headcount growth Functional Expertise Required Employee relations, compliance, benefits, compensation, performance management, and HR operations Compensation benchmarking, leveling, and benefits program design (total rewards) HCM/HRIS platforms (Rippling would be a big plus), data integrity, reporting, and AI tools Multi-state workforce management, with international exposure preferred Leadership Experience Proven experience leading a team of 4-5 direct reports and developing HR/People professionals as a player-coach Proven experience operating independently, anticipate business needs, and designing scalable solutions Mindset & Soft Skills Builder's mentality - operating at both strategic and hands-on levels Highly analytical and data-driven, with hands-on experience leveraging data to guide decisions Strong judgment in sensitive situations, confidentiality, and decisiveness Executive presence and business acumen Strong judgment in employee relations and compliance . SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR is a nice-to-have, not a requirement. What matters is the track record, the judgment, and the genuine excitement to help Tekmetric build something great - and make our people operations a true competitive advantage as we scale. Why You'll Love Working With Us Health & Wellness That Have You Covered: Enjoy the flexibility of remote work Competitive base salaries that reflect your value. Generous Paid Time Off, because we know you do your best work when you're well-rested. Support for every stage of life—with paid maternity, parental bonding, and medical leave for you or your loved ones. Comprehensive health benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription coverage. For employee only, we offer plans that cover 100% of premiums and we cover 50% of costs for families. Prioritizing your mental health: get free, confidential counseling through our partnership with BetterHelp. Investing in Your Future (and Present): 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% employer match on contributions up to 6% - so your future self will thank you. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) to make your money go further. Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance for added peace of mind. Wellness on your terms: get up to $60/month toward fitness, mental health, or almost anything that helps you feel your best. After one year of employment, enjoy a $300 home office setup bonus to help make your space work for you. Keep growing with support for continuing education - we’re invested in your development. Most importantly, we have a stellar team of coworkers, a really cool office, and lots of fun activities! Tekmetric is an equal opportunity employer. We hire hard-working individuals, regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. Tekmetric will never ask for your personal financial or banking information or require any financial commitment as part of our candidate search or application process. No job offers will be made without a formal interview process. All legitimate Tekmetric job postings are listed at tekmetric.com/careers . Recruiter communications come from @tekmetric .com email addresses. Please visit this link for further information Fraudulent Job Offers

title: Enterprise Account Manager, Creditors Rights & Collections
description: Location: Remote Travel required: 20% for client visits and industry events We're Proof , a high-growth startup in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We offer a best-in-class legal services platform used by thousands of law firms and property management companies. Our platform enables law firms and collections parties to access efficient, transparent, and accessible legal and document delivery services, traditionally out of reach. We are on a path to double our business this year and are building a team to help us scale rapidly. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds who are eager to help build a future where legal services are readily accessible, affordable, and efficient. If you have curiosity, passion, and a collaborative spirit to drive change in an outdated industry, we want you on our team. About the Role: We are hiring an Account Manager to own the post-contract relationship for our Creditors' Rights accounts. You take the handoff from the sales team at contract signing and own everything from there: onboarding, ramp, retention, and growth. New logos are assigned to you throughout the year as they close. The firms you will be managing file thousands of cases a month across multiple states, run formal audit programs, and hold their vendors to documented SLAs. You need to know their workflow, their plaintiff clients, and their operational requirements. The right person is organized, proactive, and comfortable with operational complexity. You do not wait for clients to surface problems. You understand what good looks like for a creditors' rights firm and you hold Proof accountable to it. What You'll Do: Onboarding and Scoping Take the handoff from the Account Executive at contract signing and lead the firm through onboarding. Define state footprint, plaintiff client mix, reporting requirements, serve attempt rules, e-filing setup, and exception handling. Set ramp milestones, volume targets, and reporting cadence with the firm in the first 30 days. Document and share these internally so every team member knows what was committed. Ensure the platform is configured to match what was sold. What the contract says and what the system does need to be the same thing. Identify and resolve onboarding blockers early, whether that is alt-service setup, e-filing registration, bulk upload format, or platform access, before they delay volume. Partner with the Solutions Architect to ensure customer success. Retention and Account Health Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for your accounts. You are the person a Managing Partner or Director of Operations reaches out to when something is wrong, and you own getting it resolved. Maintain a regular communication cadence, monthly reviews for core accounts and formal QBRs for enterprise accounts. Monitor account health: serve rate, filing SLA adherence, volume trends, open job aging, complaint rate. Surface negative trends before the client does. Flag at-risk accounts early and escalate internally with enough specificity that the team can act on it. Expansion and Growth Find and develop expansion opportunities within your existing book. New states, new plaintiff clients, new service types. You own the commercial conversation on expansion. You identify the opportunity, you propose and negotiate the expanded scope, and you onboard it. Own renewal conversations. You know the account better than anyone and you are responsible for making the case for renewal and negotiating the terms. Platform and Industry Fluency Develop deep knowledge of the Proof platform. You need to know what it can do, what it cannot, how to configure it correctly, and where the edge cases are. Understand the end-to-end service of process workflow: job creation, server assignment, attempt cadence, affidavit generation, e-filing, and billing. Learn the state-specific service of process rules for your accounts' active jurisdictions. At minimum, you should know what constitutes valid service, what the filing SLA is, and what alt-service options exist. What You'll Bring: Required 3 or more years of account management or client services experience in a B2B environment. Experience working with creditors’ rights law firms, law firms generally, or in the legal services space is strongly preferred. Strong organizational discipline. You manage a multi-account book without dropping things, keep your notes and CRM current, and close every open item. Clear, direct communication skills. You can write a straightforward status update to a Managing Partner and a clear internal escalation to an ops team in the same afternoon. Proactive mindset. You surface problems before they become crises. You do not wait for a client to bring you something you should have caught. Comfort with operational complexity. This is not a role where the product does everything cleanly. You will regularly manage billing exceptions, filing delays, alt-service disputes, and e-filing issues. Ability to learn new legal and regulatory frameworks quickly. You do not need to be an expert on day one, but you need to get there fast. Strongly Preferred Experience working with creditors' rights law firms or in the broader law firm space. You understand how these firms operate, who makes decisions, and what matters to them. Familiarity with service of process: service attempts, affidavit of service, e-filing, substituted service. Or a demonstrated ability to get fluent within 60 days. Prior experience with legal technology platforms, case management software, or process serving systems. Exposure to compliance-driven client relationships with audit programs, vendor questionnaires, SLA reporting requirements, and formal review cadences. Why Proof The Market Creditors' rights firms are under increasing pressure to use vendors that can document clean service, hold up under audit, and file on time across multiple jurisdictions. Proof is purpose-built for that environment. The firms filing the most cases are actively looking for a better solution, and we are the platform positioned to win that business. The Role The creditors' rights team is small and moving fast. You will have direct visibility into every account, direct access to the leadership making product and operational decisions, and real ownership over outcomes. This is not a role where you manage a queue. Compensation $130,000 base salary ($170,000 OTE) Benefits Medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, and 401k available Work-from-home monthly stipend Flexible time off (paid planned and sick time, and paid holidays) Necessary equipment provided E-Verify This company participates in E-Verify, for more information view the Participation and Right to Work Posters.

title: Senior Account Executive, Creditors Rights & Collections
description: We're Proof , a technology-enabled legal services platform built for the largest and most operationally demanding legal organizations in the country. We work with high-volume creditors’ rights law firms, major debt buyers, and institutional property management operators — helping them serve defendants, file cases, manage affidavits, and navigate complex multi-state jurisdictional requirements through a single national platform. Our creditors’ rights division, spanning consumer collections, debt buying, and the broader accounts receivable management (ARM) industry is the fastest-growing part of our business. Firms representing many of the largest debt buyers in the country are filing at record volumes in 2026. We are the platform built to support that scale — with jurisdictional rules hard-coded at dispatch, GPS-verified documentation on every job, automated affidavit generation, and SOC 2 Type 2 certification. We are not a referral network. We are a purpose-built operational infrastructure for firms that need to serve tens of thousands of defendants a month with precision and compliance. About the Role: We are hiring a Senior Account Executive to lead new business development in our Creditors’ Rights and consumer collections division. This is an enterprise hunter role — you will own the full sales motion from prospecting to close for the largest debt buyers and creditors’ rights law firms in the country. The accounts you are selling into are sophisticated, volume-driven, and relationship-first. They care about compliance, documentation quality, jurisdictional accuracy, and throughput. This is not a volume-dial SDR-supported role. You will need to build relationships at the Managing Partner, Director of Operations, and VP of Legal Operations level. Your credibility, your knowledge of the creditors’ rights and debt collection process, and your ability to connect Proof ’s platform to their specific operational pain is how you win. The right person has sold into legal collections, debt buying, or the account receivable management (ARM) industry or a comparably regulated industry requiring complex compliance and documentation. You can speak knowledgeably about the creditors’ rights process and engage a partner at a top creditors’ rights firm as a peer, not as a salesperson. What You'll Do: Enterprise Pipeline Development Own a named account list of the highest-priority creditors’ rights law firms and major debt buyers in the country, and the law firms they engage in every state they file Build and execute a strategic outbound motion — executive outreach, industry conference presence, referrals from existing Proof clients, and event-driven cultivation Develop and maintain a 12-18 month pipeline with consistent 45-60 day senior-level touches on all target accounts — when the timing is right, Proof’s name is the one they call Full-Cycle Enterprise Sales Lead consultative discovery with senior decision makers — Managing Partners, Directors of Operations, Legal Operations leads — to surface workflow bottlenecks, jurisdictional compliance risks, and documentation gaps Navigate multi-stakeholder deals across operations, legal, compliance, and IT — with deal cycles typically ranging from 3-6 months for enterprise accounts Deliver tailored presentations and demos that connect Proof’s platform directly to a firm’s specific state footprint, plaintiff mix, and volume profile Own the commercial negotiation and close, including enterprise pricing, multi-year agreements, volume tier structures Manage a clean, accurate forecast in HubSpot with consistent pipeline hygiene and disciplined stage progression Account Expansion & Ramp Management Partner with the Account Management team at customer kickoff. Work alongside the Account Manager for the first three quarters, following a mutual success plan that defines committed volume targets, reporting cadence, and ramp milestones. Maintain executive-level relationships within existing accounts to drive volume expansion into new states, new plaintiff types, and new practice areas Partner with the AM team on QBRs and strategic account reviews for your largest accounts Industry Presence Represent Proof at major creditors’ rights industry events Host executive dinners and private client events in key markets ( to build and deepen relationships with target accounts What You'll Bring: Required 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience with at least 3 years selling into creditors’ rights, consumer collections, debt buying, legal services, financial services, or a regulated industry with complex compliance requirements Demonstrated track record of landing and expanding enterprise accounts, deals above $200K annually, 6+ month cycles, multi-stakeholder environments Familiarity with the creditors’ rights and consumer collections ecosystem. You know how major debt buyers work with their law firm partners Understanding of the legal process serving workflow including service of process, affidavit of service, substituted service rules, e-filing, judgment motions — or the demonstrated ability to learn it fast and speak fluently about it within 90 days Executive presence and consultative selling skills. You can hold a meaningful conversation with a Managing Partner or VP of Operations about their actual operational pain, not just a product feature Strong pipeline discipline - you own your number, you build your own outbound, and you keep your CRM accurate without being asked Willingness to travel to industry conferences and client visits. Estimated 20-25% travel Strongly Preferred Prior experience selling to creditors’ rights law firms, debt buyers, or the ARM industry directly Existing relationships at high-volume creditors’ rights law firms Relationships at major debt buyers Experience with legal technology, process serving platforms, e-filing systems, or case management software Familiarity with state-by-state service of process requirements across your target markets Active presence in national or state creditors’ rights industry and bar associations such as RMAI, ACA International, NCBA. Compensation $200,000-$250,000 OTE based on experience, location, and performance Benefits Full time, remote, salary position Medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, and 401k available Phone and Internet monthly stipend Flexible time off (paid planned and sick time, and paid holidays) E-Verify This company participates in E-Verify, for more information view the Participation and Right to Work Posters.

title: Information Security Lead
description: Remote (+/- 2hrs from Germany, GMT+1). C1 or C2 English language proficiency is essential At Secfix, we’re at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work. Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with hubs in Munich, Berlin and London. We’re a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader. We’ve just raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. About the Role We're hiring an Information Security Lead to strengthen our compliance function as Secfix scales into more frameworks, mid-market customers, and a growing compliance team. This role sits at the intersection of compliance delivery, content, and team support. You'll own the compliance knowledge that lives inside our platform, manage our compliance specialists, support our customer success team, and act as the senior compliance voice for customers, auditors, and product. You'll work closely with our co-founders and our CS Lead. This is a high-impact role with real influence on how Secfix delivers compliance: both as a service to customers and as content inside our app. What You'll Do: You will own one of the most important pillars of Secfix: the quality and breadth of our compliance offering . We don't (and can't afford to) micro-manage. We've built strong foundations and will give you full context on what works. You can test new approaches, but at the end of the day, you have full ownership of how you deliver results (with a strong support network from within and outside the company). You will: Own and drive the compliance roadmap inside the Secfix platform across different compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, TISAX, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS 2, DORA, ISO 27017/27018, ISO 42001, C5, and more as we expand) Implement ISO 27001 and adjacent frameworks end-to-end for customers Hire, manage and upskill the compliance team: sharing expertise, reviewing work, and helping drive consistency in audits and customer deliverables Conduct internal audits directly for strategic and complex customers, and review the internal audits performed by team members to drive quality and consistency Act as a compliance partner to CSMs and sales reps: fast, reliable support for customer questions, and joining customer calls when deep expertise is needed Own the quality of compliance content in the platform (including creating policies, evidence templates, compliance-enabled playbooks for our CSMs, security awareness trainings and more) Close framework gaps and incorporate auditor feedback into both team practice and platform improvements Partner with product and engineering to translate compliance gaps into structured product work Collaborate closely with CS, Product, and Founders to align compliance, customer, and roadmap priorities Deepen relationships with our existing certification partners and train auditors on the Secfix platform so they can confidently use it during customer audits To be qualified for this role, you must have the following: English (fluent) is a must for this role 7+ years of hands‑on information security and GRC experience in B2B SaaS, including at least 2 years in an InfoSec leadership role Led 5+ successful ISO 27001 certification projects as an implementer and/or auditor at a startup or mid-market company Hands-on experience with a GRC platform like Secfix, or similar GRC platforms Cloud infrastructure readiness across AWS, Azure, and GCP; experience with posture analysis and remediation planning Strong project management skills with the ability to break down ambiguous initiatives into concrete deliverables, prioritise ruthlessly, and ship Excellent written communication, especially in producing clear, precise compliance content for diverse audiences (auditors, founders, engineers) Strong ownership mindset: operates as a senior individual contributor without waiting for direction Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field Bonus: Experience implementing one or two additional compliance frameworks (e.g. SOC 2, GDPR, NIS 2, etc.) Experience in a startup environment is a plus What we offer Remote Work: 100% remote work with a virtual office in Gather. Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab. Equity: Generous equity package – we’re all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success. Mentorship: We are backed by top VCs and accelerators and have direct access to world-class mentors. Development Budget: €1,000 annual personal development budget. Home office Budget: Home office budget and access to co-working spaces. Holidays: 26 days holiday + local public holidays. Health Insurance: Comprehensive health coverage. Annual Retreat: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (this year we spent an amazing time in Alicante, Spain!). Company Events: Company-wide events to build relationships and have some fun! Tech Equipment: Latest tech equipment (MacBook, monitors, headphones). Interview Process: 45 min - Intro call with Talent team Take-home Assessment 1.5hr Assessment review and interview with our CS Lead and CEO 45 min - Final Founder Interview with Co-Founders (CTO & CISO) Please note: We are an equal-opportunity employer and remote-only company. At this time, we can support hiring only within EU time zones. We work in sync using Gather as our virtual office. As a small fast-growing company, we believe in the need for an in-sync component of daily communication and therefore cannot support 100% asynchronous work. Read more about our Remote Culture here . title: AI-Native Static Ad Designer
description: About Uplane Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building the AI technology for the marketing agency of the future. Our software supports creative producers with static ad creation, video ad creation, landing page design, and much more. In this role, you will work with our self-developed AI static ad engine to create and deliver static ads for the paid social campaigns of our clients. You are in charge, the AI helps you fulfill your mission. Creative Testing: You develop new angles, hooks and visual concepts, test them in live campaigns and double down on what performs. Team Collaboration: Work with an ambitious team of marketing managers and creative designers to ensure projects are executed to a high standard and in a timely manner. Shape the AI engine: Give feedback to our product and engineering team and shape how our static ad engine will evolve and improve over time. Requirements Passion for designing ads, you love design and creative work Years of experience in designing static ads Work experience in paid social or with performance marketing campaigns Fast learner, hard-working, and stress-resistant Curious and excited about AI rather than afraid of it Fluent English Nice to Have Work experience at a marketing agency You have won awards for your creative work You worked with big brands before Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Fraud Investigator, Part Time Team
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. Days off are Sunday, Monday and Tuesday.</strong></p> <p><strong>Permanent Sunday Rotation: Wednesday, Thursday and Friday, 5:00pm–10:00pm, and Sunday, 11:00am–7:30pm. Days off are Monday, Tuesday and Saturday.</strong></p> <p>Candidates will be assigned to either the permanent Saturday or permanent Sunday rotation.</p> <p><strong>Our Fraud Team⭐</strong></p> <p>As a Fraud Investigator within our Prevent pillar, you will be at the absolute frontline of our mission to earn and keep our customers’ trust while building a safer society. Your primary focus is providing vital, real-time intervention for customers facing active fraud attempts, specifically managing risks across authorised card and faster payment channels. This is a high-impact, proactive role where you won't just be reviewing cases—you'll be taking decisive action, which includes making calls to guide customers through stressful situations and secure their funds. By preventing losses before they happen, you become a crucial contributor to Monzo’s safe growth and a key defender against financial crime in the industry.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Real-Time Investigation:</strong> Gather and analyse evidence from flagged transaction data to identify active fraud attempts.</li> <li><strong>High-Stakes Decision Making:</strong> Make confident, independent—and at times collaborative—decisions to either release or block suspicious transactions.</li> <li><strong>Customer Intervention:</strong> Use Monzo’s values to investigate suspicious activity via phone and chat, balancing professional curiosity with deep empathy.</li> <li><strong>Active Safeguarding:</strong> Support and reassure customers during active fraud scares, securing compromised accounts and taking remedial action so they can resume safe banking.</li> <li><strong>Case Triage & Review:</strong> Effectively triage incoming cases and review customer limit increase requests to mitigate potential risk.</li> <li><strong>Account Integrity:</strong> Where investigations reveal first-party concerns, manage the account closure process in strict accordance with internal guidance.</li> <li><strong>Educational Support:</strong> Empower victims of fraud by providing tailored advice on how to protect themselves from future threats.</li> <li><strong>Operational Excellence:</strong> Complete all necessary post-investigation activity with high attention to detail to ensure a clean audit trail.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <p>Fraud Investigators within our Prevent pillar work within unregulated but critical deadlines.  </p> <ul> <li>You enjoy a telephony role as this forms the core part of being a successful investigator.</li> <li>You bring experience from Banking, Financial Services (e.g., FOS, HMRC), or have a Law Enforcement background.</li> <li>You are a Fraud Specialist is ideal but not necessary as full training will be provided: You are familiar with common fraud typologies and have a strong foundation in investigative problem-solving.</li> <li>Investigative Rigour: The ability to probe deeply during an investigation and clearly explain the "why" behind your final decisions.</li> <li>You are a decisive communicator: You possess excellent English written and verbal skills, with the ability to be persuasive yet empathetic. You can make confident, concise decisions under pressure.</li> <li>You are an independent collaborator: You thrive when working autonomously but value being part of a wider, supportive team.</li> <li>You are mission-driven<strong>:</strong> You are genuinely excited about our mission to make money work for everyone and approach your work through the lens of Monzo’s core values.</li> <li>Empathetic: Exceptional communication skills used to handle difficult customer conversations, particularly when educating victims to "break the spell" of a scam while remaining firm and professional. You're confident in communicating across all channels (phone, in-app chat, and email), handling both inbound and outbound calls with care.</li> <li>Feedback-driven Mindset<strong>:</strong> A proactive approach to continuous improvement, consistently seeking out and acting upon feedback to refine your craft.</li> <li>Solution-oriented problem-solving: You bring solutions rather than just highlighting obstacles, providing kind and constructive feedback to your peers to help the collective grow.</li> <li>Decisive independence<strong>:</strong> The confidence to make firm, independent decisions on complex cases without an excessive reliance on second opinions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £16,620–£21,360 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance (Pro-Rata) </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a> (Pro Rata) </p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Some initial application questions (please take your time, we read these carefully!)</li> <li>Recruiter Call</li> <li>A remote interview, lasting approximately 1 hour with two team members from the Prevent Team. </li> </ul> <p><strong>⏰Training</strong></p> <p>Training schedule: You’ll complete an 11-week training programme, working the same permanent Saturday or Sunday rotation that you’ll continue on once training is complete.</p> <p><strong>START DATE: January 18th, 2027</strong></p> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p> We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-REMOTE<strong> </strong>#LI-SK</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Meta Ads & Full-Funnel Growth - 100% remote
description: Wir sind eine stark wachsende Direct-to-Consumer-Marke im Gesundheitsbereich und verkaufen hochwertige Supplements direkt an unsere Kund:innen. Unsere wichtigste Wachstumsmaschine: Direct-Response-Marketing über Meta Ads. Ein hoher ROAS ist für uns kein Ziel – meistens ist er ein Zeichen dafür, dass zu wenig ausgegeben wird. Wir steuern auf Wachstum: Neukunden, CM3, aMER, MER und ein CAC, der sich am Kundenwert misst. Wenn du ohnehin in Deckungsbeiträgen und CAC/CLV denkst statt in Plattformkennzahlen, ist das hier dein Standard. Wenn nicht, ist es die falsche Stelle. Wir suchen jemanden, der den kompletten Funnel von der Ad über das Offer und die Landingpage bis zum Kauf als ein System versteht, systematisch testet und Budget dorthin bringt, wo es profitables Wachstum erzeugt – auch wenn das auf Plattformebene erstmal unbequem aussieht. Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben Media Buying auf Wachstum steuern: Du verantwortest unsere Paid-Social-Konten eigenständig – Budget, Kampagnensetup, Adsets, Creatives einbuchen. Du skalierst, solange die Unit Economics tragen, und skalierst nicht, um Plattformmetriken zu schonen. Full-Funnel-Diagnose: Du analysierst regelmäßig den gesamten Weg von Ad über Offer und Landingpage bis zur Conversion, findest den größten Engpass und priorisierst genau dort. Creative Testing & Creative Diversity: Du entwickelst Testhypothesen, bewertest Creative-Performance und sorgst dafür, dass das Konto nicht von zwei Winning Ads abhängt: verschiedene Angles, Formate, Creator und Hooks parallel im Test, damit Skalierung nicht an Creative Fatigue scheitert. Learnings gehen konkret und datenbasiert an Creative Strategist und Copywriting zurück. Offer- und Landingpage-Tests koordinieren: Du priorisierst den Test-Backlog für Bundles, Preislogik, Value Stack, Message-Match und Landingpage-Struktur, briefst die Fachteams, wertest aus und rollst Gewinner aus. Steuerung nach Gesamtwirtschaftlichkeit: Deine Entscheidungsgrundlage sind Neukunden, CM3, aMER, MER und CAC im Verhältnis zum Kundenwert – nicht der ROAS einer einzelnen Kampagne. Attribution & Datenqualität: Du liest Performance nicht aus dem Ads Manager, sondern aus unserem Attributionsmodell. Du weißt, wo Plattform-Attribution und Realität auseinanderlaufen, sorgst für saubere Datenerfassung und klärst Auffälligkeiten früh mit IT. Struktur & Reporting: Einheitliche Naming Convention, nachvollziehbare Account-Struktur, feste Reporting- und Review-Routinen für Wachstum, Budget und Learnings. Qualifikation Dein Profil Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Media Buying für Meta Ads im D2C-Kontext – du hast eigenverantwortlich Budgets gesteuert und ein Konto profitabel wachsen lassen , nicht nur effizient gehalten. Du kannst erklären, warum ein Konto mit ROAS 1,0 und wachsendem Neukundenstamm mehr wert ist als eines mit ROAS 4 und stagnierendem Umsatz – und du hast das schon einmal jemandem erklären müssen. Du denkst in Funnels und Kohorten: Du weißt, dass ein schlechter Neukunden-CAC auch am Offer oder an der Landingpage liegen kann, und dass der Wert eines Neukunden erst nach dem ersten Kauf entsteht. Testgetrieben: Du setzt Tests mit klarer Hypothese, Erfolgskriterium und Auswertungslogik auf und dokumentierst, was du lernst. Sicher in Datenanalyse und Attribution – du hast mit Attributionstools jenseits des Ads Managers gearbeitet, kennst die Grenzen von Plattform-Attribution und Tracking-Setups (Pixel, CAPI, UTMs) und erkennst, wenn Daten nicht stimmen. Du kennst gängige DR-Mechaniken (Hook–Problem–Solution, Value Stack, Social Proof, Scarcity) und kannst beurteilen, warum ein Creative oder Offer performt. Du weißt, dass Creative Diversity kein Kreativ-Nice-to-have ist, sondern die Voraussetzung dafür, dass ein Konto skaliert – und planst deinen Testing-Mix entsprechend. Du arbeitest gern mit Creative-, Copy- und Web-Teams zusammen – als Taktgeber mit klaren Briefings, nicht als Einzelkämpfer. AI-Tools für Reporting, Anomalie-Erkennung und Creative-Analyse nutzt du bereits Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Supplement- oder Health-Brands. 🛠 So arbeitest du bei uns Du bekommst volle Verantwortung für die Paid-Social-Konten und ein Team, das zusammen mit dir Creatives, Copy, Landingpages und Tracking bearbeitet – du priorisierst, was gerade am Wichtigsten ist. Du steuerst mit denselben Zahlen wie die Geschäftsführung: CM3, aMER, MER, Neukunden, Kundenwert. Kein separates „Marketing-Dashboard", das schöner aussieht als die Realität. Wir arbeiten mit Notion für Prozesse, Slack fürs Team und einem eigenen Attributionsstack, in den wir laufend investieren – du steuerst nach diesen Zahlen, nicht nach Meta's Zahlen. Rollen sind bei uns klar definiert: Objective, Job Results, KPIs. Du weißt, wofür du verantwortlich bist – und was nicht. Entscheidungen fallen auf Basis von Daten. Wenn die Daten fehlen, holen wir sie, bevor wir raten. Benefits Was dich erwartet Eine Marke mit klarer Positionierung und Produkten, perfekt für unsere Zielgruppe – und eine Organisation, die Paid Social als Wachstumsmotor denkt, nicht als Kostenstelle. Kurze Entscheidungswege, echtes Mandat über Budget und Testing. Regelmäßige Performance-Reviews und Learnings – wir skalieren, was funktioniert, und dokumentieren, warum. Remote-Only mit klaren Prozessen und hoher Eigenverantwortung Die Möglichkeit, das Performance-Marketing-System einer wachsenden Health-Brand von Grund auf mitzubauen – und mit ihr zu wachsen. Let's grow it! Du denkst in Full-Funnel, Neukunden, Deckungsbeiträgen und hast den den CLV im Blick? Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem Lebenslauf, zwei bis drei konkreten Beispielen, in denen du Meta Ads mit Direct Response Mechaniken zum Wachstum geführt hast und einem kurzen Statement, warum du in unser Team gehörst. title: AI Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an AI Engineer at GitLab, you'll help build the foundation for GitLab's transformation into an AI-first company. Reporting to the Director, Enterprise AI, you'll be a hands-on technical leader responsible for delivering internal AI-powered solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.</p> <p>Building fast matters, but it's not enough on its own. This role starts with understanding the real problem: mapping how work moves across teams, tools, and handoffs, identifying the true constraint, and validating whether AI is the right solution before you begin development. From there, you'll take ownership from discovery through deployment, combining strong engineering skills with systems thinking and business understanding.</p> <p>Your initial focus will span Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support, where you will embed AI solutions into key systems and workflows. This role offers the opportunity to shape how GitLab team members work, improve flow across the organization, and help advance our mission in a remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Diagnose business problems before building solutions. Map workflows, identify constraints, and confirm whether AI is the right intervention. Be prepared to say "this doesn't need AI" when that's the honest answer.</li> <li>Own AI initiatives end-to-end, from stakeholder discovery and technical design through implementation, deployment, and iteration.</li> <li>Design, develop, and ship AI-powered solutions quickly, delivering working prototypes in days, not months, with a focus on practical outcomes and measurable business value.</li> <li>Improve organizational flow by building solutions that reduce bottlenecks, shorten lead times, and increase throughput. Measure success using flow metrics alongside adoption and ROI.</li> <li>Integrate AI capabilities into existing systems and workflows using APIs, orchestration tools, and modern AI platforms, including GitLab Duo Agent Platform, where appropriate. The right tool wins, whether that's custom code, a platform, or a well-crafted prompt.</li> <li>Be Customer Zero: leverage and showcase GitLab's AI offerings wherever possible, feeding real-world usage insights back to R&D.</li> <li>Partner closely with stakeholders across functions to understand the real constraints. Ask the right questions, bridge technical and non-technical perspectives, and align on outcomes before jumping to solutions.</li> <li>Define and track success through business metrics, flow metrics, and feedback loops that make performance visible and actionable.</li> <li>Contribute to technical direction by evaluating tools, documenting patterns, and creating reusable foundations that help the team scale its impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>A Technologist at Heart - </strong>Genuinely invested in technology, the foundational and the cutting-edge in equal measure. You're as energised by a well-designed API integration as you are by the latest foundation model release. You reach for the simplest solution that solves the problem well, rather than forcing new technology when proven approaches would do. AI is a powerful part of your toolkit, but it sits on top of solid engineering fundamentals, not in place of them.</li> <li><strong>Competent, Confident Coding Skills - </strong>You can build working solutions end-to-end, write clean and maintainable code, and debug effectively. Whether your skills were honed in a traditional engineering role, through building automations, or shipping side projects, what matters is that you can deliver production-quality work independently.</li> <li><strong>AI</strong><strong> & LLM </strong><strong>Technical Depth - </strong>Strong proficiency in at least one modern scripting language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) and a solid understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns. Deep, practical experience with modern AI technologies, specifically: Prompt engineering as a core discipline: designing effective system prompts, managing context windows, structuring multi-turn interactions, evaluating output quality, and iterating systematically on prompt design.</li> <li><strong>Model selection and cost-performance trade-offs: </strong>understanding when a smaller fine-tuned model outperforms a general-purpose large one, when RAG is the right architecture versus expanding the context window, and how to make principled decisions about capability versus cost.</li> <li><strong>Agentic architecture patterns: </strong>tool use, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop designs, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and production-grade reliability patterns.Practical fluency across the LLM ecosystem: hands-on experience with models from Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source alternatives, and the judgment to know which to reach for and when.</li> <li><strong>AI Safety & Risk Awareness - </strong>You think critically about how the solutions you build could be exploited, misused, or produce unintended consequences. You know how to design appropriate guardrails (input validation, output filtering, access controls, prompt injection defences, and data leakage prevention) and you treat these as first-class engineering concerns.</li> <li><strong>Systems Thinking & Diagnostic Rigour - </strong>The ability to look at a complex process and see the constraint. Comfortable mapping how work flows end-to-end, identifying bottlenecks, and tracing problems to root causes before proposing solutions. You instinctively ask "what's actually blocking flow here?" before asking "what model should I use?"</li> <li><strong>Business System Expertise - </strong>Familiarity with the landscape of enterprise business systems, CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Marketo), support platforms (Zendesk), integration and orchestration tools (Workato), AI platforms (Relevance AI), and enterprise search and knowledge tools (Glean). You don't need deep experience with all of these, but to understand what they do, how they fit together, and be willing to build with and across them. A strong understanding of enterprise data models and workflows is essential.</li> <li><strong>Broad Functional Understanding - </strong>Ability to have meaningful conversations with stakeholders across diverse domains and quickly understand their unique needs.</li> <li><strong>End-to-End Ownership - </strong>Track record of owning complex initiatives from discovery through delivery. Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving to measurable outcomes independently.</li> <li><strong>Product Mindset - </strong>Ability to scope MVPs, prioritise ruthlessly, and deliver iteratively. In addition, consider adoption, user experience, and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Preferred requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with GitLab platform and CI/CD workflows</li> <li>Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical roles</li> <li>Familiarity with value stream mapping, flow metrics, or Theory of Constraints thinking</li> <li>Experience with low-code/no-code orchestration tools (n8n, Make, Workato) alongside custom development</li> <li>Previous startup or high-growth company experience</li> <li>Experience mentoring or leading technical projects with junior engineers</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>You will join the Enterprise Technology & AI team. We're the backbone of the organisation, driving transformation in how GitLab team members make decisions, operate at scale, and deliver results for our customers.</p> <p>We believe the best AI solutions start with understanding the system, not the technology. We value people who think in constraints and flow, who build with conviction, and who never stop learning. We work in an all-remote, asynchronous setting, guided by GitLab's values of collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move from strategy to execution without heavy oversight.</p> <p>This role reports to the Vice President, Enablement & AI.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li><strong>AI Enablement Roadmap:</strong> Own and continuously evolve the roadmap for AI-driven enablement initiatives, prioritizing based on field impact, feasibility, and alignment with broader Enterprise AI team and strategy..</li> <li><strong>AI Field Use Cases:</strong> Identify, scope, and execute on high-value AI use cases for the field (e.g., deal support, prospecting, content generation, guided selling, skills, change management), working with stakeholders to define success criteria and measure impact.</li> <li><strong>AI Field Champions: </strong>build relationships with champions in the field organization to activate power-usage and drive peer-led adoption; track this adoption (e.g., usage, proficiency, behavior change) with our AI Ops Specialist and Enablement Analyst.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Ops Transformation Plan:</strong> Design and drive the operational plan that turns AI pilots into scaled, repeatable processes, coordinating across enablement, ops, and technical teams to remove execution bottlenecks.</li> <li><strong>AI Governance:</strong> Influence and lead governance standards for AI tool adoption in the field, including data usage, risk review, tool vetting, and alignment with company-wide AI policy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Mid-Senior Experience:</strong> Several years of experience in enablement, sales operations, or a related GTM function, with a track record of owning initiatives end-to-end.</li> <li><strong>AI Solutions Experience:</strong> Direct experience evaluating, piloting, or deploying AI tools or solutions in a business context, with a solid technical understanding of how they work and where they add value. Act as the field's primary advocate for AI tools (e.g., AI-assisted prospecting, call intelligence, forecasting copilots, RFP/proposal generation).</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Fluency:</strong> Proven ability to work closely with product and engineering teams, translating field needs into technical requirements and vice versa.</li> <li><strong>Self-Sufficiency:</strong> Comfortable operating with significant autonomy — able to define scope, structure ambiguous problems, and drive work forward without needing detailed direction.</li> <li><strong>Organization & Execution:</strong> Strong project management instincts; able to manage multiple workstreams (roadmap, use cases, ops transformation, governance) in parallel without dropping details.</li> <li><strong>Innovative Mindset:</strong> A builder's orientation toward new technology — curious about what's possible, willing to experiment, and able to separate genuine opportunity from hype.</li> <li><strong>Enablement/Sales Background:</strong> Familiarity with field or sales enablement motions (onboarding, tool adoption, content, coaching) and how AI can realistically augment them.</li> <li><strong>GitLab Values Alignment:</strong> Ability to work in an all-remote, asynchronous environment, leaning heavily on transparency and collaboration as defined in the GitLab Handbook.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Enablement & AI function is part of the CRO organization. Enablement is instrumental in helping GitLab grow at a more accelerated pace and achieve our ambitious revenue targets. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them.</p> <p>Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it.</p> <p>You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <h3>Strategy & Prioritization</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own your function's AI strategy,</strong> aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time.</li> <li><strong>Map how work flows</strong> across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before?</li> <li><strong>Manage intake</strong> of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently.</li> <li><strong>Prioritize strategically</strong> against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work.</li> </ul> <h3>Adoption & Change Management</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Reimagine, not just automate.</strong> Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.</li> <li><strong>Drive adoption and change management</strong> together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick.</li> <li><strong>Coordinate with Enterprise AI</strong> to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business.</li> <li><strong>Build and bridge the Champion network in your function.</strong> Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly. From early in the role, identify and recruit Champions across sub-teams (5-10% time, formally agreed with their manager), run a regular Champion sync, host demos to the wider function, and act as their bridge to Enterprise AI. Champions are not your reports: you coordinate them, you don't manage them. Without this network, your reach is capped.</li> </ul> <h3>Hands-On Building & Agent Operations</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Build AI agents</strong> using no-code and low-code platforms (e.g. Glean, Workato, similar tools). Go from idea to working prototype without waiting for engineering.</li> <li><strong>Author and iterate on skills files</strong> that define how AI agents behave. Refine instructions based on real usage and share reusable skills across the function.</li> <li><strong>Configure MCP servers and tools,</strong> giving agents access to the business systems they need. Partner with the AI Engineer on what to connect and how to do it securely.</li> <li><strong>Own your function's fleet of agents.</strong> Some agents will be used directly by people in your org. Those that aren't, you own. Either way, you're accountable for their performance: tracking KPIs, running evaluations after model or data changes, and iterating based on what you learn.</li> <li><strong>Expect to rebuild.</strong> AI tools and models evolve fast. The agent you built last month may need to be replaced, not patched. You should be comfortable sunsetting your own work when a better approach emerges, and helping your org stay current rather than attached to what exists today.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <h3>Business & Strategic</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Deep knowledge of your function's operations.</strong> You understand how work moves through your org, where it gets stuck, and why. You can trace a process end-to-end and explain how it connects to the teams around it.</li> <li><strong>Strategic prioritization skills.</strong> You've managed competing demands before and can make hard calls about what matters most. You think in terms of business outcomes, not activity.</li> <li><strong>A product management mindset.</strong> You naturally think about intake, backlog, iteration, and adoption. You're comfortable defining success metrics and holding yourself accountable to them.</li> <li><strong>Strong communication and influence.</strong> You'll be the person saying "not yet" to some teams and "think bigger" to others. You need the credibility and interpersonal skills to make both of those conversations land.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional instincts.</strong> You default to understanding how your org's processes affect and are affected by the teams around you - not just optimising in isolation.</li> <li><strong>Experience building peer networks or communities of practice.</strong> You've recruited and sustained volunteer contributors before, whether as a guild lead, champion program owner, or community organizer. You know how to motivate people whose time you don't directly own.</li> </ul> <h3>Hands-On & Technical</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Comfortable building with AI tools.</strong> You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to build a working agent, configure a skill, connect an MCP server, and troubleshoot when something isn't working. Think: power user, not software engineer.</li> <li><strong>Ready to learn fast.</strong> Experience with or willingness to quickly pick up no-code/low-code AI platforms, prompt engineering, and agent configuration. You'll be trained on GitLab's specific tooling, but you should arrive ready to get your hands dirty.</li> <li><strong>Strong conceptual understanding of AI capabilities</strong> - summarization, classification, generation, automation, agentic workflows - and a commitment to staying current. The landscape shifts constantly. The tools you use today may be obsolete in weeks. You stay on top of new developments so that your org's AI strategy reflects what's actually possible, not what was possible six months ago.</li> <li><strong>Ability to map data flows</strong> - structured and unstructured. Understand where agents need context, and figure out where humans should interface with automated workflows and at what steps.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>You will partner closely with Enterprise AI within the Enterprise Technology & AI organization, while remaining embedded in your own function. Enterprise AI provides the technical delivery capability, platforms, and patterns. You provide the business context, prioritization, building at the no-code layer, and adoption muscle. Together, you form the core of your function's AI transformation.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>This is a contract opportunity -- individuals must be based in EMEA</strong></h4> <h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Candidate Experience Specialist, you'll shape how candidates experience GitLab from first touch through offer and handoff to our People Operations team. You'll be a key partner to Recruiters, hiring managers, and recruiting leadership, helping them execute hiring plans, coordinate interviews, and maintain accurate, transparent processes in our applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories. You'll act as a brand ambassador who embodies our values in every interaction, ensuring candidates receive timely, thoughtful communication and a consistent, high quality experience across a high volume of roles. You’ll focus on building strong relationships with hiring teams, improving and standardizing coordination workflows, and supporting GitLab's goal of hiring a qualified, diverse, and motivated team in our all-remote, global environment.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Recruiters, hiring teams, and Recruiting leadership to understand and execute the hiring plan for each job requisition.</li> <li>Coordinate with Recruiters to maintain accurate, up-to-date hiring process information in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li>Manage candidate scheduling and act as the Recruiting Coordinator to organize interviews and keep hiring processes running smoothly.</li> <li>Ensure candidates receive timely, thoughtful, and engaging communication at each stage of the hiring process.</li> <li>Help manage candidate traffic for all roles, monitoring pipelines and flagging issues or bottlenecks to the recruiting team.</li> <li>Create and stage employment contracts for candidates receiving offers on behalf of hiring managers and Recruiters.</li> <li>Partner with People Operations to create a seamless handoff for new team members joining GitLab.</li> <li>Promote GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction, acting as a brand ambassador for potential team members.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting end to end hiring processes in partnership with recruiters and hiring managers, ideally in a fast paced or high volume environment.</li> <li>Skill using an applicant tracking system to schedule, track, and move candidates through interview stages; Greenhouse experience is beneficial but not required.</li> <li>Proficiency with Google Workspace, scheduling tools,  and a willingness to learn and use additional tools.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in writing and verbally with candidates and internal stakeholders at all levels, including executives.</li> <li>Demonstrated strength in organization, time management, and prioritization, with a consistent focus on meeting deadlines and maintaining attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to build collaborative relationships with team members across time zones and functions while maintaining a high level of confidentiality.</li> <li>Interest in learning about talent acquisition and contributing to an inclusive hiring process that attracts a qualified, diverse, and motivated team.</li> <li>Alignment with GitLab's values and comfort working in an all remote, asynchronous environment, including flexibility in your working hours to support candidates and hiring teams across multiple time zones, with openness to transferable experience from related coordination or operations roles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Candidate Experience team partners with Recruiters, hiring managers, and People Operations to run a smooth, consistent, and inclusive hiring process across GitLab's all-remote, global organization. for both technical and executive stakeholders.</li> <li value="7">Proven ability to build trusted advisor relationships, facilitate workshops, and guide customers through best practices and operational change.</li> <li value="8">Openness to learning, with transferable skills from adjacent roles or industries that support collaborative, outcome-focused customer partnerships.</li> </ul> hands-on labs, office hours, adoption plays, and executive engagements—that increase customer reach and impact.</li> <li>Partner with Professional Services to create continuity from implementation through adoption, including high-quality handoffs and clear ownership after delivery.</li> <li>Ensure CSE capacity is focused on the moments that most improve adoption, time-to-value, customer health, <li>Build the capabilities required to help customers adopt GitLab’s strategic use cases, including GitLab Duo and the Duo Agent Platform where relevant to customer objectives.</li> <li>Use product-usage data, customer feedback, success-plan progress, and health signals to identify risk and prioritize intervention.</li> <li>Establish repeatable plays to accelerate onboarding, remove adoption blockers, increase breadth and depth of use, and support customers in achieving measurable value.</li> <li>Partner with Sales and Renewal Management to turn adoption progress and outcome evidence into a credible expansion and renewal narrative.</li> </ul> <h4>Own operational excellence and business performance</h4> <ul> <li>Establish a disciplined cadence for forecasting, customer other systems of record.</li> <li>Ensure customer escalations are handled with clear ownership, appropriate executive engagement, and timely cross-functional coordination.</li> <li>Identify systemic friction in the customer journey and lead continuous-improvement initiatives that scale across EMEA and globally.</li> </ul> <h4>Build and develop an exceptional team</h4> <ul> <li>Recruit, develop, culture consistent with GitLab’s values and all-remote ways of working.</li> <li>Use talent, capacity, and organizational design decisions to ensure the team can support a changing portfolio and evolving product strategy.</li> </ul> <h4>Partner across the revenue and product ecosystem</h4> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with regional Sales and Renewal Management leaders while opportunities.</li> <li>Bring structured customer insight to Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing, and Enablement.</li> <li>Orchestrate executive engagement for strategic customers and high-severity risks.</li> <li>Collaborate with global Customer Success leaders to standardize what should scale and preserve the regional adaptations that improve customer impact.</li> </ul> <h3>What objectives, and GitLab’s values, serving as a subject-matter resource for legal colleagues and cross-functional partners.</li> <li>Directly manage matters across the employment lifecycle, including recruiting and onboarding, compensation, performance management, leave management, employee relations, works council processes, organizational changes, separation, and post-employment issues.</li> in, or directly manage outside counsel appearances for, labor courts, employment tribunals, and agency investigations, including case strategy, fact development, witness preparation, and settlement decisions.</li> <li>Counsel People Business Partners, Team Member Relations partners, and business leaders on complex and sensitive team-member relations concerns.</li> <li>Draft, review, negotiate, and maintain employment agreements, separation agreements, policies, templates, and related documentation across multiple jurisdictions.</li> <li>Own employment compliance across EMEA and incorporate outside-counsel input into strategies that match the business.</li> <li>Monitor and analyze changes in employment, privacy, and related laws; identify legal risks; and translate developments into practical recommendations and implementable guidance.</li> <li>Lead the development and continuous improvement of scalable employment-law processes, systems, playbooks, templates, and supporting documentation for the Legal and People teams.</li> <li>Provide employment advice in regions outside EMEA as needed.</li> <li>Use GitLab to collaborate transparently and work effectively in an asynchronous, globally distributed environment.<br><br></li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll bring</h3> <ul> <li>A Juris Doctor (JD), Bachelor of Laws (LLB), or local equivalent, admitted to practice in at least one EMEA jurisdiction.</li> <li>Substantial, firsthand experience advising a multinational company with works councils across EMEA, including direct hands-on negotiation and consultation experience.</li> <li>A demonstrated track record of advocating or managing outside counsel in labor courts, employment tribunals and analogous proceedings .</li> <li>Deep knowledge of employment compliance requirements across EMEA, with the judgment to identify when advice from local counsel is needed.</li> <li>Experience counseling People Business Partners, Team Member Relations partners, and business leaders on sensitive and complex employment matters, including works council strategy.</li> <li>Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating employment agreements, separation agreements, policies, templates, and related documentation across multiple jurisdictions.</li> <li>Fluency with GDPR and other local privacy requirements related to team-member data.</li>
