There are two levels of seniority available — we will determine together what best fits you during the interview process.</p> <p><strong>Where you could join:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Core </strong>is the foundation of Monzo. It's where we build the products millions of people use every day: from Current Accounts and Joint Accounts to Pots, Subscriptions, Savings Challenge, and all the moments that make managing money feel effortless. This is a role for someone who believes the best product experiences come from getting the fundamentals right, and wants to shape products that become part of people's daily lives.</li> <li><strong>Borrowing</strong> is helping customers access credit simply, transparently, and responsibly. Today that includes growing products like Flex, Loans, Credit Insights, Mortgages, and Overdrafts in the UK, while also taking Monzo's Flex proposition to millions more customers across Europe. This is a role for someone excited by the challenge of growing an established proposition at home while shaping how it succeeds in new markets; understanding local customer needs, refining the proposition, and helping build the foundations for Monzo to win internationally.</li> <li><strong>Wealth </strong>is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work and make growing money feel simpler, more accessible, and more rewarding for everyday customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own Product Marketing for a Product. </strong>You'll define a 2–4 quarter Product Marketing strategy that connects customer needs, market opportunity, and product direction into a clear plan. You'll own Product Marketing across the full product lifecycle from early discovery through launches and iteration. You'll be the go-to person for understanding how your product succeeds in the market.</li> <li><strong>Become the expert on your market. </strong>You'll build a deep understanding of your customers, competitors, and category, using research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities that influence product priorities. You'll bring the voice of the market into day-to-day product decisions and help your squad make better bets.</li> <li><strong>Define positioning customers understand. </strong>You'll create clear, differentiated positioning and messaging that helps customers understand why your product matters. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Writers, and Integrated Marketing to ensure that positioning is reflected consistently across the product experience and everything customers see.</li> <li><strong>Influence Product Strategy. </strong>You'll work alongside Product Managers, Designers, and Researchers to shape product strategy with customer and market insight. Product teams will seek your perspective before committing to product bets, and you'll help turn customer problems into products people genuinely love.</li> <li><strong>Shape successful launches. </strong>You'll design launch strategies that fit the customer problem, partner with Integrated Marketing on campaigns, and coordinate cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Support. You'll measure what worked, learn quickly, and continuously improve how your product reaches customers.</li> <li><strong>Measure what matters. </strong>You'll use customer and commercial data to understand whether your work is making a difference. You'll build business cases for product decisions, measure launches against meaningful outcomes, and use what you learn to strengthen positioning, propositions, and future product decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This is for you if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You enjoy owning entire products.</strong> You're comfortable taking responsibility for Product Marketing across a full product experience, from customer insight through to positioning. </li> <li><strong>You solve ambiguous problems with evidence.</strong> You enjoy understanding customers, identifying market opportunities and turning insight into practical product and marketing recommendations.</li> <li><strong>You know what makes products win.</strong> You combine customer insight, market understanding and commercial thinking to build products and propositions people genuinely love.</li> <li><strong>You influence through collaboration.</strong> You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Researchers and Integrated Marketing, bringing people with you through evidence rather than authority.</li> <li><strong>You're always improving and helping others improve.</strong> You seek feedback, develop your craft and contribute to making the team stronger through sharing knowledge and helping others. Mentor more junior team members informally.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (30mins) </li> <li>Case Study Presentation (45mins)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>£70,000 - £105,000 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"><strong>here</strong><strong> </strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Business Banking

title: Senior Security Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. Central to this is making sure the bank is safe and secure for our customers. We’re always keen to hear from people who believe in our mission and want to join us on this journey.</p> <p>We’re looking for a proactive, curious, technically-minded and organised Senior Security Analyst to join Monzo's Security team. </p> <p>Our team is Monzo’s front door to Security, helping the whole business operate securely. This means you’ll get exposure to a wide range of business context and a broad mix of information security work. One day you might be assessing the security of a new supplier; the next you could be supporting an audit or assurance review, assessing the risks of a new product or technology change, updating a policy, or helping a team turn regulatory requirements into practical action.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with security specialists, engineers, product teams, third party risk, procurement, and colleagues from across Monzo to solve interesting problems and strengthen how we effectively manage security risk as we grow.</p> <p>We want security to protect Monzo without creating unnecessary friction or compromising user experience. You’ll have the opportunity to make a notable impact in an environment where security is both a priority and an opportunity for innovation! <br><br></p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Delivering third party security and supplier security assurance: assess new and existing suppliers, reviewing questionnaires, certifications, and other evidence to understand their security posture. Use your judgement to identify risks, translate technical findings into recommendations, and work with teams across Monzo to manage them throughout the supplier lifecycle. Help us build a more effective, scalable and industry-leading third party security capability as Monzo grows!</li> <li>Delivering security assurance activities: lead and contribute to control testing, PCI DSS assessments, regulatory reviews, and internal and external audits. Evaluate evidence, identify gaps and work with teams across Monzo to see findings and remediation through to completion.</li> <li>Strengthening our governance: improve security policies, procedures and controls so they’re practical, proportionate, and reflect how things work in reality. </li> <li>Supporting our Security Front Door: work alongside our other analysts to respond to security questions and requests from across Monzo, bringing in specialists when needed and finding ways to make the experience better for other Monzonauts.</li> <li>Taking ownership and running with it: turn loosely defined security problems into clear outcomes, work out the best way forward, and bring in the right people to make it happen.</li> <li>Helping teams build and change safely: work with engineers, product teams and other colleagues to understand what they’re trying to achieve. Review new products and technology or business changes, identify security risks and control gaps, and turn security and regulatory expectations into requirements that work in practice.</li> <li>Improving how we work: use data, automation and AI to make our processes simpler and more scalable, while exploring new ways technology can help us work smarter.</li> <li>Raising the bar for security: bring fresh perspectives to real-world security challenges, keep developing your own skills and knowledge, and help less experienced analysts grow.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You understand security risk: you’re comfortable identifying and assessing security risks, and can recommend proportionate ways to manage them. Experience in third party security or supplier security assurance would be a bonus!</li> <li>You can evaluate security evidence: you can review supplier questionnaires, security policies, penetration test reports and assurance evidence, and know when to dig deeper.</li> <li>You have strong security fundamentals and technical curiosity: you understand core security concepts and good practice, are comfortable getting into technical detail, and ask thoughtful questions to get to the heart of a problem.</li> <li>You think beyond the task in front of you: you look for patterns and root causes, use evidence and data to prioritise and look for ways to make things work better.</li> <li>You’re proactive: you can make progress independently, seek out the information you need, and are comfortable challenging assumptions to move things forward.</li> <li>You can manage competing priorities: you can juggle different pieces of work, keep people informed, and make sensible decisions about what needs attention or escalation.</li> <li>You’re a clear communicator: you can explain security risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences in a way that works for them.</li> <li>You enjoy collaborating: you like working with people across different disciplines, building strong relationships, and helping make security easier to do well.</li> <li>You’re passionate about security: you’re excited by the challenges and opportunities in cyber security, keep up with an evolving industry, and are motivated to continue developing your knowledge and skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙏 It would be great if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ve worked in financial services, fintech, or another highly regulated environment.</li> <li>You’ve supported PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2 or NIST-aligned assurance, regulatory reviews, or internal and external audits.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £57,000 - £70,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Intro call with the recruiter</li> <li>30 min call with the hiring manager</li> <li>2 hours of technical and behavioural interviews</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. culture where engineers hold each other to that standard</strong>.</li> <li>Proactively mentor, sponsor and <strong data-start="3229" data-end="3276">develop senior engineers and future leaders</strong>, multiplying your impact by enabling others to operate at a higher level.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll be using/ What you’ll be working on: </strong></p> <p>We rely heavily on href="https://tour.golang.org/welcome/1"> <strong>here</strong></a>)</li> <li><a href="http://cassandra.apache.org/"><strong>Cassandra</strong></a> for most persistent data storage</li> <li><a to hear from you if… </strong></p> <ul> <li data-section-id="1lw0ku1" data-start="527" data-end="650">You have a track record of <strong data-start="556" data-end="650">leading complex, high-impact data-start="1119" data-end="1172">mentoring and raising the bar for other engineers</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>How we work 💻</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working: </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 Base salary £155,000 - £200,000 + Equity</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves four main stages after an informal recruiter call: </p> <ol> <li>Recruiter Call </li> <li>Initial Call </li> <li>System Design Interview </li> <li>Take home task or pair coding exercise </li> <li>Final interview including a behavioural and a leadership interview </li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>One of our staff engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/23/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process"> <strong>here</strong></a>.</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> &

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. These are some of Monzo's most loved experiences, and they're at the heart of how customers interact with us.</p> <p>As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Senior User Research Manager to help shape the future of Personal Banking. This is an opportunity to lead research across one of Monzo's largest product areas, influence company strategy, and develop exceptional research leaders.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You'll be responsible for both people leadership and strategic research leadership. This includes:</p> <ul> <li>Leading research across Core Banking while helping shape a coherent Personal Banking research strategy that spans multiple product areas.</li> <li>Partnering closely with the Core Banking Leadership Team, Product Directors, Design leaders and senior stakeholders across Wealth, Payments, Borrowing and our European business.</li> <li>Helping define and land parts of Monzo's global research operating model as we expand internationally, ensuring teams work effectively across both global and local markets.</li> <li>Connecting customer insights across collectives, identifying themes, opportunities and gaps rather than viewing research through the lens of a single team.</li> <li>Bringing together existing research, product data, market insights and quantitative evidence to help leadership make informed strategic decisions.</li> <li>Managing managers and supporting approximately 6-8 direct and indirect reports while maintaining a consistently high bar for research quality.</li> <li>Creating an environment where researchers can balance methodological rigour with the speed needed to build great products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <p>You have experience with:</p> <ul> <li>Leading senior researchers and/or research managers within a complex product organisation.</li> <li>Shaping and influencing product strategy through research at both organisational and executive level.</li> <li>Working across multiple product areas, bringing together disparate customer insights into a coherent strategic narrative.</li> <li>Navigating complex stakeholder environments where different teams have competing priorities, metrics and timelines.</li> <li>Partnering with Product, Design, Engineering and Data Science leaders to influence roadmaps and business strategy.</li> <li>Combining qualitative research with quantitative signals, product data and market insights to develop strategic recommendations.</li> <li>Building alignment across large organisations and landing new ways of working with multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>Coaching research leaders while maintaining a high quality bar across multiple teams.</li> <li>Making thoughtful trade-offs between research depth, pace and business impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £110,000 - £150,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK. </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <p><strong>Recruiter call (30 minutes):</strong> A conversation with one of our recruiters to learn more about your background, motivations, and what you're looking for next, while giving you the opportunity to learn more about Monzo and the role.<br><strong>Leadership & Ways of Working (45 minutes):</strong> We'll explore your leadership experience, approach to research strategy, and how you raise the research quality bar.<br><strong>Final loop (Total 1hr 30 - 2 hours):</strong> Two interviews covering <strong>Managing Teams & People</strong> and <strong>Leadership & Impact</strong>, where we'll discuss your approach to developing research leaders, building high-performing teams, influencing strategy, and driving organisational impact.</p> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-LG1  #LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Staff Analytics Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Staff Analytics Engineer - Borrowing</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £121,600-164,600 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance and<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Borrowing Analytics Engineering Team</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>Our mission in Borrowing is to help people achieve their financial goals through better borrowing. Our customers borrow money to achieve something in their lives — whether that’s making a big life event affordable, buying something they need now without affecting their monthly budget, or getting by until payday. We’re shaping this mission by building products our customers love, while safely scaling some of Monzo’s biggest revenue lines.</p> <p>Borrowing is one of Monzo’s most complex and fastest-growing domains. We operate 12+ products across multiple geographies, underpinned by 1,700+ data models and an analytics engineering team that’s scaling to match. We’re in the middle of a major data architecture transformation, expanding into new markets, and building the next generation of data infrastructure to support it all.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Staff Analytics Engineer to help shape how Borrowing builds and uses data at scale. Reporting to the Borrowing Data Director, you’ll work across product, credit, engineering, Data Platform, and analytics engineering teams to turn complex technical problems into clearer systems, stronger data products, and better business decisions.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Architecting Borrowing’s data layer at scale.</strong> Partnering across Analytics Engineering, Product, Engineering, Credit, and Data Platform to shape how 1,700+ models across 12+ products are structured, connected, and evolved. You’ll set shared patterns that help teams build trusted, consistent, and scalable data products across Borrowing.</li> <li><strong>Designing and governing data products</strong>. Moving us beyond ad-hoc tables toward well-defined, contractual data assets with clear ownership, SLAs, documentation, and interfaces. You’ll work with teams across Borrowing and Data Platform to define what makes a Borrowing dataset “production-grade” and consumable by analytics, ML, decisioning, and regulatory teams.</li> <li><strong>Building feature stores and reusable analytical assets</strong>. Identifying cross-product signals (credit behaviour, repayment patterns, affordability, risk indicators) that should be modelled once, tested rigorously, and consumed by many. You’ll design the layer that turns raw product data into curated, versioned features that power models, dashboards, and decisions.</li> <li><strong>Scaling our analytics engineering infrastructure</strong>. Shaping the tooling, patterns, and developer experience that make an 80+ person credit and data organisation more productive. This means influencing our data architecture and ways of working across data and credit disciplines, while partnering with the central Data Platform team to ensure Borrowing’s needs are reflected in ingestion, streaming, and schema contract design.</li> <li><strong>Driving cross-product data consistency</strong>. As we expand across geographies and product lines, ensuring our data models are coherent and comparable. You’ll work with AE leads and domain experts to define shared conventions and abstractions that allow us to reason about Borrowing as a whole, not just product-by-product.</li> <li><strong>Being a senior technical partner for Borrowing’s data estate.</strong> Partnering with backend engineers on source data payload design, with product managers on measurement strategy, with credit teams on decisioning data, and with senior leadership on what’s possible and what’s next.</li> <li><strong>Leading through influence and leverage. </strong>You won’t manage people directly, but you’ll shape how an entire domain builds data. You’ll multiply the impact of AEs across Borrowing by setting the right patterns, unblocking architectural decisions, and raising the bar on what good looks like.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You think in systems, not just queries.</strong> You’ve designed data architectures that span multiple products or domains, and you know how to keep them coherent as they scale. You can take ambiguous problems and turn them into a clear technical direction, delivery sequence, and set of trade-offs.</li> <li><strong>You’ve built data products, not just data models.</strong> You understand the difference between a table that exists and a data asset that’s governed, documented, versioned, discoverable, and trusted. You’ve defined SLAs, contracts, interfaces, or ownership models for data consumers, and you’re excited to do this at scale.</li> <li><strong>You have deep fluency with analytics engineering systems and infrastructure.</strong> dbt at scale, BigQuery or equivalent, CI/CD for data, testing frameworks, and orchestration. You don’t just use these tools, you shape how teams use them. You’ve hit the scaling limits and know what to do about them.</li> <li><strong>You can design reusable feature layers.</strong> You’ve designed, contributed to, or have a clear vision for reusable feature layers that serve multiple consumers, including ML pipelines, dashboards, decisioning engines, and regulatory reporting. You understand the trade-offs between freshness, cost, granularity, correctness, and ease of use.</li> <li><strong>You’re comfortable at the platform boundary.</strong> You can have a productive conversation with a Data Platform engineer about ingestion patterns, streaming vs. batch trade-offs, schema evolution, and infrastructure costs. You don’t need to build the platform, but you need to shape what it delivers.</li> <li><strong>You connect technical choices to business outcomes.</strong> You care about whether data models, feature layers, and platform patterns actually improve decisions. You understand how product, credit, engineering, and operational teams use data, and you use that context to align people around better technical choices.</li> <li><strong>You lead through others.</strong> You create leverage not by writing more SQL, but by setting patterns, reviewing designs, unblocking teams, and raising the standard. You’re energised by making 30+ people more effective, not by being the single expert.</li> <li><strong>You communicate across altitudes.</strong> You can whiteboard a data architecture with a back-end engineer in the morning and present a strategic data roadmap to a director in the afternoon. You adapt your message to your audience without losing precision.</li> <li><strong>You care about credit products.</strong> You’re excited, or curious, about the complexity of lending, including risk, affordability, regulatory constraints, and multi-product dynamics. You see it as a fascinating data domain, not just a business vertical.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview process</strong></p> <p>Our typical process is structured as:</p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call</li> <li>Initial call  </li> <li>3 x 1 hours sessions (final interview)</li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰  £121,600-164,600 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance and<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a></p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕ And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> <strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-AS #LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Staff Backend Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London / UK Remote | 💰 <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-0.pdf">Staff Backend Engineer (L60)</a> £130,000 - £170,000 + Equity + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a> - Engineering  </p> <p><strong>About our Engineering Teams:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We contribute to </span><a href="https://github.com/monzo"><strong>open source software</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> as much as possible. Our </span><a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology"><strong>blog</strong></a><strong> </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">is a good place to learn even more about what we do!</span></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on: </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial </span><a href="https://tour.golang.org/welcome/1"><strong>here</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="http://cassandra.apache.org/"><strong>Cassandra</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for most persistent data storage</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="http://kafka.apache.org/"><strong>Kafka</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for our asynchronous message queue</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://www.envoyproxy.io/"><strong>Envoy Proxy</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for RPC</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="http://kubernetes.io/"><strong>Kubernetes</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and </span><a href="https://www.docker.com/"><strong>Docker</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to schedule and run our services </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="http://aws.amazon.com/"><strong>AWS</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for most of our infrastructure</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><a href="https://facebook.github.io/react/"><strong>React</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> for internal web dashboards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">We also have two physical datacenter sites with actual cables to connect to various third parties</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Your day-to-day   </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This role is all about collaborating across disciplines to test hypotheses and make a difference to customers. As a product backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! </span></p> <p>Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). Our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront - from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.</span></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working: </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're on the look out for L60 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our<a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf"> Engineering Progression Framework</a> we are also hiring on L40 & L50, our interview process will determine your levelling. </span></p> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our interview process involves three main stages: </span></p> <ol> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Initial Call </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take home task or pair coding exercise </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Final interview including a system design and a behavioural interview </span></li> </ol> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see </span><a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/23/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process"><strong>here</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">💰 £130,000 - £170,000 + Equity</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">✈️We can help you relocate to the UK </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">✅ We can sponsor visas.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">📍This role can be based in our London office or remotely across the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you

title: Talent Management
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is entering a new chapter of People work: more AI-native, more strategic, and more focused on building systems that help every Notino do the best work of their career. We're building toward a four-pronged People Consulting model: - Strategic People Partners who steer orgs as the consultative layer closest to the business. - Talent Management is the systems and programmatic engine layer — talent programs, systems and resourcing work that support our People Partners & talent density. - People Relations is the primary arm and escalation point for employee relations. - People Operations owns the operational layer of the end-to-end employee lifecycle, a layer we're increasingly scaling through agentic services. We are looking for the right person to join our existing Talent Management arm. This person will help define, operationalize, and continuously improve how we grow talent at Notion. This role sits at the intersection of talent philosophy, people partner strategy and enablement. This is not a siloed program role. It is an extension of our strategic People Partner & Talent Management org: someone who brings deep talent management craft, strong business judgment, and the operating muscle to turn philosophy into practice across the company. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: 1. Maintain and operationalize Notion’s talent philosophies - Codify and evolve our talent philosophies across performance, growth, leadership, career development, internal mobility, early career, and high-performance expectations. - Translate principles into practical tools, rituals, and operating mechanisms that People Partners and leaders can use. - Ensure our philosophies stay connected to business needs, company strategy, and the realities of how work is changing. - Ensure the talent systems we build are durable and make talent expectations clear, consistent, and actionable — without over-programming or adding unnecessary process. 2. Co-build the programmatic layer & talent engine for People Partners - Help steer and co-build the overall talent enablement engine equipping People Partners to drive higher-quality actions with leaders. If People Partners are consultants, our talent management arm builds the resources to enable talent density. - Keep our core philosophies aligned with our deployment-ready materials: playbooks, manager guides, conversation frameworks, decision tools, calibration support, and coaching resources. - Partner closely with strategic People Partner leaders to identify where enablement is needed most and how it should show up in the business. Develop net new, creative strategies aligned with Notion’s values and vision. - Ensure People Partners are not just consuming talent programs, but actively shaping and deploying them with context and judgment. 3. Enable talent density - Bring the taste, craft, and pattern recognition to understand what different talent segments need to grow. - Design self-service strategies & actions that help leaders develop talent - Power up our mechanisms to better identify, engage, stretch, and retain talent. - Enable our leadership bench. 4. Lead fluid, high-leverage talent strategy projects This role will flex into the highest-priority talent questions of the moment. Examples of historical and potential high-impact projects include: - Early career strategy enablement: helping define the scaffolding, manager expectations, growth model, and experience needed to make Notion a definitive launchpad for early-career talent. - Total rewards exploration: partnering with Total Rewards, Talent, and People leaders to explore what recognition could look like in a more AI-native, high-performance environment. - Role architecture for the next generation of work: rethinking how roles, levels, career paths, and talent systems should evolve as AI changes what people can do. - Internal mobility and talent flow: partnering with People Ops, Recruiting and People partners in creating clearer, higher-touch pathways for high-slope talent to find the right next opportunity inside Notion. - Leadership expectations: supporting the translation of Notion’s leadership philosophy into practical enablement for managers and leaders. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Significant experience designing, scaling, and evolving talent management strategies and programs (e.g. performance, talent reviews, succession planning, career architecture, or related initiatives). - Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional change without formal authority. - Experience translating ambiguous talent philosophies into scalable tools, frameworks, and operating mechanisms. - Strong business acumen and organizational judgment, with the ability to connect talent decisions to company outcomes. - Excitement for reimagining talent management in an AI-native world. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $270,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Partner Sales Director - IHV Alliances
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced <strong>IHV Alliance Sales Director</strong> to join our strategic partnerships team who will be responsible for leading IHV Alliances globally, in AMER, EMEA or APAC regions. Reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances, the IHV Alliance Sales Director will work closely with IHV and Canonical teams in those geographies to develop and maintain strong relationships with senior executives at strategic partner organizations, fostering collaboration and alignment on joint business objectives. The IHV Alliance Sales Director will manage and grow a team of Business Development Managers and help them identify and pursue new business opportunities with IHVs, driving revenue growth and market expansion, develop and execute go-to-market strategies for joint offerings, oversee the day-to-day management of alliances including contract negotiations and performance tracking, and issue resolution. </p> <p>The Director is responsible for building trusted relationships with IHV partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelising the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and lead executive engagements.</p> <p>Location: This role will be based remotely in AMER, EMEA or APAC regions.</p> <p><strong>As an IHV Alliance Sales Director you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build strategic relationships with IHV partners at all levels</li> <li>Grow their awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu</li> <li>Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem</li> <li>Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms</li> <li>Demonstrate a deep understanding of large and complex organizations</li> <li>Lead partnerships in APAC with companies like Lenovo, Huawei, Quanta, Fujitsu, Inspur, H3C,  NEC, Asus etc.</li> <li>Lead partnerships in EMEA with companies like Ericsson, Nokia, Bull, Siemens</li> <li>Lead partnerships in the Americas with companies like Dell, HPE, IBM, Supermicro</li> <li>Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management</li> <li>Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner</li> <li>Lead executive interlocks between IHV and Canonical leadership</li> <li>Travel regularly - sometimes internationally - to drive partnerships in person</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Valued skills and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles</li> <li>Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality</li> <li>Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities</li> <li>Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission</li> <li>Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals</li> <li>Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies.</li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for an experienced, fluent Japanese speaking Database Support Engineer to join our Support Team and help developers unblock complex issues, build more reliably, and get the most out of the Supabase platform. You’ll work closely with customers and engineering, helping us improve product quality and developer experience based on real-world usage. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR In this role, you’ll: - Investigate and resolve advanced customer issues across Postgres, Auth, RLS, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions, and client libraries. - Provide consultative, proactive advice to optimize workloads, avoid common pitfalls, and tailored advice to our most advanced users. - Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, propose workarounds, and escalate to engineering with solid repro steps. - Ask smart, targeted questions that turn incomplete reports into actionable cases. - Communicate clearly and empathetically with customer users of all levels—especially during high-impact or time-sensitive situations. - Spot patterns across tickets and recommend improvements to docs, tooling, and the product itself. - Mentor junior team members and help raise the overall bar for support quality. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - You have 6+ years in technical support, backend engineering, SRE, or similar. - You know PostgreSQL deeply—autovacuum behavior, WAL growth, long-running transactions, table bloat, and other internals. - You’re strong in high-performance SQL and query optimization. - You’re comfortable troubleshooting complex setups, including multi-tenant schema patterns. - You can debug edge functions and understand distributed system behavior when failures get tricky. - You’ve handled data migration issues (pg_dump/restore, schema drift, failed migrations) and know how to recover safely. - You have hands-on experience with cloud hosting providers like AWS. - You’re comfortable in terminal and Linux environments. - You thrive in high-volume situations and can form/test assumptions quickly. ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS - Must be a fluent bilingual Japanese/English Speaker - Must have experience support complex technical products in Japanese with native speakers - Ideally located in Japan, but location is flexible as long as you can work during Japan business hours. データベースサポートエンジニア Supabaseについて Supabaseは、開発者が開発者のために作ったPostgres開発プラットフォームです。データベース、認証、ストレージ、Edge Functions、リアルタイム機能、ベクトル検索を含む、完全なバックエンドソリューションを提供しています。すべてのサービスは緊密に統合されており、成長に対応できるよう設計されています。 職務内容について 経験豊富な日本語で対応可能なデータベースサポートエンジニアを募集し、サポートチームに参加していただきます。開発者の複雑な課題解決を支援し、より信頼性の高い開発を実現し、Supabaseプラットフォームを最大限に活用していただけるようサポートします。お客様やグローバルのエンジニアリングチームと密接に連携し、実際の利用状況に基づいて製品品質や開発者体験の向上に貢献していただきます。 このポジションは、非同期かつスピード感のある環境で力を発揮でき、数百万人規模で利用される開発者ツールの構築にやりがいを感じる方に最適です。 主な業務内容 このポジションでは、以下の業務を担当していただきます。 - Postgres、認証、RLS、ストレージ、リアルタイム機能、Edge Functions、クライアントライブラリにまたがる高度な顧客課題の調査・解決 - ワークロードの最適化やよくある落とし穴の回避に向けたコンサルティング的かつ積極的なアドバイスの提供、および最も高度なユーザーへの個別対応 - バグの再現、根本原因の特定、回避策の提案、および確実な再現手順を伴うエンジニアリングチームへのエスカレーション - 不完全な報告内容を対応可能な案件に変えるための、的確で的を絞った質問 - あらゆるレベルの顧客ユーザーとの明確かつ思いやりのあるコミュニケーション(特に影響度が高い、または緊急性の高い状況において) - チケット全体からパターンを見出し、ドキュメント、ツール、製品自体の改善を提案 - ジュニアメンバーの育成、サポート品質全体の向上への貢献 以下に当てはまる方はこのポジションに向いています - テクニカルサポート、バックエンドエンジニアリング、SRE、または類似職種で6年以上の経験がある方 - PostgreSQLに関する深い知識をお持ちの方(autovacuumの挙動、WALの増加、長時間実行トランザクション、テーブルの肥大化などの内部構造を含む) - 高パフォーマンスなSQLおよびクエリ最適化に強みをお持ちの方 - マルチテナントのスキーマパターンを含む、複雑な構成のトラブルシューティングに抵抗がない方 - Edge Functionsのデバッグができ、障害が複雑化した際の分散システムの挙動を理解できる方 - データ移行に関する問題(pg_dump/restore、スキーマの差異、移行失敗など)に対応した経験があり、安全な復旧方法を理解している方 - AWSなどのクラウドホスティングプロバイダーでの実務経験がある方 - ターミナルおよびLinux環境に抵抗なく対応できる方 - 業務量の多い状況でも力を発揮でき、素早く仮説を立てて検証できる方 追加要件 - 日本語・英語のバイリンガルであること - 日本語の顧客を対象に、技術製品のサポートを行った経験があること - 日本在住が望ましいですが、日本の勤務時間帯に対応できれば勤務地は柔軟に対応可能です WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
description: About KIRA Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone. Â In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Â Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading. Â These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges. Â The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch. Â We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted. Â What You'll Own Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery. Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability. Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience. Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing. Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling. Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners. Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements. Â What We're Looking For 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production. Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems. Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs. Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain. Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints. Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used. Â Nice to have Engineering or highly technical product background. Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products. Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products. Â Outcome Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction Location This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: Online assessment or practical task Technical interview CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. title: Frontend Engineer
description: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations Our objective is to organise anyone's life. Â Role As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work. Â What You'll Own Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets. Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets. Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications. Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows. Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices. Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly. Â What We're Looking For Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies. Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance. Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces. Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces. Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details. Able to independently own features from technical design through production. Â Outcomes Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable. AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences. Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows. Â Tech Stack TypeScript React.js / Next.js HTML / CSS WebSockets / streaming APIs Node.js REST / GraphQL APIs Â How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product. Â Interview Process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally. title: Senior Tax Accountant
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion’s Tax team is growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Tax Accountant to support our global tax operations. In this role, you’ll run global indirect tax operations and strengthen the systems behind them. As Notion scales across products and jurisdictions, this role exists to make compliance, close, audits, and tax data more accurate, scalable, and audit-ready. You’ll own recurring sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business tax, registrations, notices, reconciliations, and related controls, while building exposure to income tax compliance and reporting. The work is hands-on and cross-functional: you’ll trace differences across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger with Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience partners. This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Take ownership of recurring U.S. and global indirect-tax filings, calendars, data packages, notices, registrations, and close support—with accurate, review-ready work. - Establish a reliable reconciliation and exception workflow across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger, escalating issues clearly and early. - Use AI-enabled workflows and data tools to investigate variances, quality-check work papers, and improve documentation while preserving human review and controls. - Make tax operations more scalable and audit-ready by strengthening controls, process documentation, evidence, handoffs, audit support, and SOX walkthrough readiness. - Become a trusted partner to Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience—and contribute to income tax compliance and reporting with guidance from experienced teammates. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. - At least 3 years of public accounting and/or industry tax experience, with a primary focus on indirect tax compliance and operations. - Hands-on experience with indirect tax compliance or operations, especially U.S. sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business taxes, or other non-income-based taxes; this is the foundation for owning Notion’s recurring global work. - Experience preparing accurate reconciliations, journal entries, filings, payments, and audit-ready work papers, with the ability to connect activity across source systems and the general ledger. - Strong operational judgment: you manage recurring deadlines, investigate exceptions, keep documentation organized, escalate issues promptly, and drive assigned work through completion. - Clear written and verbal communication, with a collaborative approach to working across Finance, Accounting, business teams, and external advisors. - Curiosity and learning agility, including willingness to build income-tax capability and demonstrated AI fluency—using AI to analyze data, investigate variances, improve documentation, perform quality checks, or automate repeatable workflows while validating outputs and protecting sensitive information. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $135,000 - $155,000 per year.
